question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ke ba da damar amfani da edita na nuni a matsayin taimako don nakaltar sautin waƙa

question: Wace aiki ce ta fi dacewa a yi amfani da ita lokacin zaman sauraron kiɗan kide-kide a matsayin mai motsa ji na fasaha ga ɗaliban da ba su saba da kiɗan kide-kide ba?

question: Ka yi la'akari da yanayi mai zuwa: A cikin sashin "Waka da Muhallin Sauti", wani malamin waka ya umurci ɗalibansa, a matsayin aikin gida, su bincika game da amfanin warkarwa da kuma amfani mai cutarwa na sauti, sauti mai ƙarfin gaske, da kuma sauti mai rauni ƙwarai. answer_d: Don ganin ɗalibansa sun fahimci ma'aunin gaskiyar sauti

question: A yayin aiki tare da ɗalibai kan manufa: 'Saka launi ta amfani da salon zanen impressionist.' Wane kuskure ne ɗalibai ke yi mafi yawan lokuta yayin da suke ƙoƙarin samun launuka daban-daban a cikin gaurayensu?

question: Malami na aiki tare da ɗalibansa a kan mahangar launi na alama. A lokacin darasin, ɗaya daga cikin ɗalibansa ya tambaye shi: A rayuwar yau da kullum, yaushe ake amfani da launi na alama? answer_a: Cikin launukan da aka yi amfani da su a sana'ar masaku, waɗanda suke kama da launukan yanayi

question: Malama tana tsaye a gaban aji tana gabatar da darasin fasahar bugu, sai ɗaya daga cikin ɗalibanta ya tambaya: Wane irin bugu ne ake kira intaglio kuma me ya sa? Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka na gaba ya ƙunshi amsar da malamar za ta iya bayarwa don fayyace tambayar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Fashe-fashen katako, saboda ana sassaƙa katakon da wuƙaƙe masu kaifi da kayan rabawa waɗanda ke yin zurfin faɗawa a cikin saman ma’aji na katakon.
answer_b: Buga da allon raga, saboda tawada tana ratsa zurfin zaruruwan masana'anta don ƙirƙirar bugu a kan saman abubuwa kamar takarda, yadi, ko wasu
answer_c: Zane da acid da akwatint, saboda tawadar tana shiga cikin ramukan da aka yi a farantin ƙarfe, kuma shi ya sa hoton yana fitowa ne sakamakon ramukan filatin tushen, ba samansa ba
answer_d: Buga Duwatsu, saboda nauyin duwatsu matsi, haɗe da matsin da injin bugawa ke bayarwa, yana samar da bugu inda tawada ke bayyana da ɗan tashi sama.

question: A cikin aji na firamare, malami ya gabatar da manufar cewa: 'Haɓaka fasahar lura, rarrabewa, da kuma haɗa abubuwan da ke cikin yanayi ta hanyar zane.' Don cimma wannan, malamin ya gayyaci ɗaliban su fita zuwa muhallin yanayi na halitta kusa da makaranta tare da littattafan zanensu da fensir. Wane tsari na ayyuka ne daga cikin masu zuwa zai ba ɗaliban damar cimma manufar da aka faɗa?
answer_a: Zaɓi manyan siffofin shimfiɗar ƙasar da aka lura da ita, kuma ka yi fenti, ta amfani da faci a matsayin hanyar bayyanawa
answer_b: Ku lura da yanayin, ku bayyana firam ɗin sha'awa, kuma ku fassara tsari da sifofi zuwa zane, sannan ku shafa haske da inuwa
answer_c: Yi la'akari da shimfiɗar wuri, ayyana manyan abubuwa na zaɓaɓɓen fureti, da sauƙaƙe siffofi, ta amfani da layi a matsayin hanyar furtawa
answer_d: Bayanin muhimman abubuwan da ke bayyane a shimfiɗar wuri, sannan a fassara matakai daban-daban na sararin samaniyar da za a wakilta a cikin littafin zane

question: Wace dabara ce ta fi dacewa don ƙirƙirar aiki, wanda zai sauƙaƙa wa ɗalibai fahimtar tsarin zanen Jackson Pollock?

answer_d: Yi amfani da hotunan da aka cire daga mahallinsu don ƙirƙirar kolaj

question: Menene aiki mafi dacewa don gabatar da hangen nesa ta hanyar motsa tunanin kirkire-kirkire na ɗalibai a matakin kama-ainahi (mai shekaru 12 zuwa 14)?
answer_a: Umurci ɗalibai su zana wani abu na yanayin ƙasa da suke gani ta taga. Bayan haka, su janye daga taga, su sake zana wannan abun, sannan su kwatanta girman da suka samu a zane-zanen guda biyu
answer_b: Ku ce wa ɗalibai su kwafe wani zane mai ɗauke da shimfiɗar ƙasa a sigar hangen nesa da wuraren ɓacewa guda biyu, sannan ku ce musu su kwatanta zanen nasu da ainihin zanen, suna la’akari da hangen nesan.
answer_c: Nemi ɗalibai su zana layin sararin sama, su kafa wuraren ɓacewa guda biyu, sannan su zana akwati, kuma su kwatanta siffofi daban-daban da suka samu tare da abokan karatunsu
answer_d: Buƙaci ɗalibai su shirya baje-koli inda za su bayyana dokokin amfani da layin sararin ido bisa ga hotunan da suke sha’awa

question: Malamar tana aiki a kan ɓangaren zane hoton mutum (portrait unit) tare da ɗalibai a aji na 7. Domin su kammala ɓangaren, za ta ce su zana hoton ɗan ajinsu. Wane aikin motsa jiki ya kamata ɗaliban su yi kafin su ɗauki wannan ƙalubalen?

answer_b: Kwaikwayi haskoki da inuwa da suka bayyana a fuskar abokin aji
answer_c: Kwafi ɓangarorin fuska daban-daban, kamar hanci da kunnuwa
answer_d: Zana fasalin fuska kuma sanya ɓangarorinta daidai gwargwado

question: Malami yana aiki a kan Darasin Cubism tare da ɗalibansa na aji shida kuma ya bayyana yadda ake maganin yanayin hangen nesa. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan za a iya yi tare da ɗaliban don haɓaka fahimtar manufar?

answer_c: Yi aikin gwaji na wakiltar rayuwa marar motsi da yawaitar sassa masu faɗi (ko jirage)
answer_d: Yi koyi da zanen kubist ta amfani da takardun launi masu nau'o'i daban-daban

question: Wani malami ya kai ɗalibansa gidan kayan tarihi don ganin wani nune-nune na zane-zanen shimfiɗar wuri na zamani da nufin su fahimci kyawun ado (aesthetic value) na ayyukan da aka nuna. A lokacin ziyarar, malamin ya ba su wani rubutaccen jagora don taimakawa fahimtar kyawun ado na kowane ɗayansu; dole ne su zaɓi wani aiki da ya ja hankalinsu sannan su amsa wasu tambayoyi. Wane irin tambayoyi wannan jagoran ya kamata ya ƙunsa don cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Mene ne jigon aikin kuma a cikin wane motsi aka tsara shi? Yaya kimarka a kansa kuma me ya sa?
answer_b: Wane ne marubucin aikin da menene muhimman matakan tarihin rayuwarsu? Me ya sa ka zaɓi aikin? Yaya yake da alaƙa da tarihin rayuwarka?

question: Malamar tana aiki a kan darasin: “Gumakan Zamantakewa” ta hanyar ƙirƙirar hotuna masu girma biyu; a ƙarshen aikin, tana so ta ƙididdige manufar: “Yin tunani a kan rawar da gumakan zamantakewa na zamani suke takawa.” Wane ma’aunin ƙididdigewa ne ya dace da manufar da aka faɗa?

answer_b: Bincike mai zurfi na rawa da tasirin gunkin zamantakewa da aka nuna
answer_c: Sannar da matsayinsu na kansu game da shahararren mutumin da ɗan uwansu ya ƙirƙiro a matsayin gunki a cikin jama'a
answer_d: Yana isar da yadda suka samar da hoton sada zumunta a matsayin nasu tsari

question: Wata malamar aji na 5 ta nuna wa ɗalibanta zane-zanen Chile na lokuta daban-daban, tana bayyana hanyoyi daban-daban da masu zane ke amfani da launi, siffa, da haske. Sannan, ta ƙalubalance su su zaɓi wani zane, wanda ya bambanta da waɗanda suka lura da su, domin su tantance ɗaiɗai ƙasidun harshen gani iri ɗaya da aka koya. A ƙarshe, ɗaliban sun gabatar da binciken su ga ajin. Malamar ta tantance aikin ta yin amfani da ma'aunin ci gaba (rubric). Me ya sa amfani da wannan dabara ya dace don tantance manufar da aka bayyana a aikin da ya gabata?
answer_a: Saboda ya ƙunshi aiki da fannoni daban-daban waɗanda ya kamata a bambanta su don ba da martani ga ɗalibi
answer_b: Saboda ƙa'idar tantancewa ta ba da damar haɗe-haɗe da yawa na maki da ma'auni
answer_c: Saboda ma'aunin tantancewa yana bada damar tantancewa ba tare da sanya maki ba ko yanke hukunci a kan samfurin ɗalibin, amma a kan tsarin da suka gudanar.
answer_d: Saboda kundin kimantawa yana kyale zaɓar mafi kyawun aiki daga cikin nazarin da ɗalibai suka gudanar

question: Karanta halin da ke tafe: Wani malami ya nuna wa ɗaliban aji na 8 ƙa'idar tantancewa wadda za a yi amfani da ita don tantance manufa mai zuwa: “Fassara abubuwan gani na zamani, la'akari da siffofin hanyar bayyanawa, kayan aiki, da kuma harshen gani.” Wace daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ce ta haɗa da mai nuni wanda ya kamata ya kasance a cikin ƙa'idar tantancewa?
answer_a: Kwatanta jigojin da aka bayyana a cikin aikin
answer_b: Tana bayyana godiyarta ta kashin kanta game da hanyoyin fasaha da aka yi amfani da su a aikin
answer_c: Kafa alaƙa tsakanin rubutu (texture), fasahohin da aka yi amfani da su don ƙirƙirar su, da ma'anar aikin.
answer_d: Alaƙanta alamomi da ke cikin aikin da tarihin rayuwar marubucin

question: Idan malami yana so ɗalibansa su iya bayyana halayen zamanin Baroque ta fuskar salo, a wane koyo ya kamata su fi mai da hankali?

answer_b: Gane kasancewar basso continuo

answer_d: Shaidar matakan da suka nuna farko da ƙarshen wannan lokaci, a cikin 1600 da 1750, bi da bi

question: Wace daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ce ta fi bada gudummawa kai tsaye wajen haɗa wani guntun sauti na kayan kida mai murya huɗu, tare da ƙungiyar kayan kida waɗanda ke da aƙalla kayan kida uku a kowace murya?

question:

answer_c: Haɓaka sauraron rarrabewa

question:

answer_a: Da a ke kwatanta tarin waƙoƙin/kwarewar da ake da su
answer_b: Ta hanyar bayyana manufar aikin zamantakewa

answer_d: Ta hanyar danganta halayen kiɗan da amfani da waƙoƙin"

question:
Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya:
Malamin Fasahar Kiɗa ya gayyaci ɗalibansa su yi aikin kaɗa-kaɗe na rukuni, inda, na farko, ya koya musu wata jimlar kiɗa mai matsakaicin sarkakiya, sannan kuma, jimla ta biyu. Malamin yana yin atisayen jimlolin a cikin tsarin da ke biyo baya: 1. Dukkan ɗalibai tare su kaɗa ta farko; sannan ta biyu. 2. Rabin ajin su kaɗa ta farko ɗayan rabin kuma su kaɗa ta biyu, ta haka suka samar da kiɗa mai sarke-sarke. 3. Dukkan ɗalibai a lokaci guda su maimaita aikin da aka yi yanzu, amma yanzu a bi-biyu. 4. A ƙarshe, an zaɓi ɗalibai don su kaɗa kowace jimla ta kiɗa mai sarke-sarke ɗaiɗai. Wane irin ci gaba ne aka fi haɓakawa ta hanyar aikin da aka yi a baya?
answer_a: Na fahimtarwa
answer_b: Rukuni
answer_c: Shaidar kai
answer_d: Binciken tunani da motsi

question: Karanta halin da ke gaba: A cikin aji inda malami ke bayyana nau'o'in lokutan kiɗa (time signatures) daban-daban, ya lura cewa mafi yawan ɗalibansa ba za su iya bambance lokutan kiɗan da ke da adadin bugu guda ɗaya ba, amma sun bambanta a rarrabansu (2/4 da 6/8, 3/4 da 9/8, 4/4 da 12/8). Wane aiki malamin zai yi don taimakawa ɗalibai su bambance waɗannan bambance-bambancen?
answer_a: Duba takardar kiɗa da ke nuna waɗannan bambance-bambancen
answer_b: Gyara ma'aunin lokaci na waƙoƙi masu sauƙi ta amfani da editan takardar waƙa
answer_c: Yi waƙa a cikin 6/8 tare da ɗalibai, kuma nan da nan bayan haka, canja wurin damuwa (accent) na ta don a yi ta a cikin 3/4.
answer_d: Bayyana rabon kari gida biyu (binary) da gida uku (ternary) tare da taimakon ilimin lissafi da ɗalibai ke da shi game da ɓangarorin (fractions) lambobi.

question: A cikin aji, ɗalibai dole su gane jerin sautin waƙa ta hanyar ji. Wane zaɓi ne ya fi dacewa ya nuna ƙwarewar da ɗalibai ke haɓakawa da wannan aikin?
answer_a: Sauraron banbance-banbance
answer_b: Binciken sauti
answer_c: Jiyya ta fasaha
answer_d: Sauraro mai ma'ana

question: Wace hanya ce ta tantancewa take ba da damar haɗa wata ayyuka ta kiɗa da sauran fannoni na nuna basirar fasaha?
answer_a: Dabdaben jiki na jerin waƙoƙin raye-raye masu alaƙa da sauraro
answer_b: Gudanar da labarin zube bisa ga jarrabawar kayan kida
answer_c: Yi wasa da kayan kiɗa na kayan da aka sake sarrafawa, waƙoƙin gargajiya daga al'adu daban-daban na gargajiya
answer_d: Yi guda-guda na wakoki daga hanyoyin rubuta-kiɗa na gani daban-daban

question:
Karanta alamomin tantancewa na gaba:
- Son raya son sani, sha'awa, da jin dadi ga sautuna da kida.
- Girmamawa ga nau'ikan bayyanar kida daban-daban, mahallansu, ra'ayoyinsu, da salolinsu bisa ga naka.
- Sha'awar kafa alaƙa da haɗa kida da sauran fasahohi, darussa, da rayuwa da kanta.
Da wane irin matakai masu alaƙa da koyo ne alamomin tantancewar da aka ambata suka fi alaƙa?
answer_a: Mai bayyana ji da zuciya
answer_b: Halayyar da ta shafi ɗabi'a
answer_c: Mai hangen nesa
answer_d: Na fahimta/Na sanin hankali

question: Malami na shirin aiki da ɗalibansa na shekara ta 2 ta sakandare a kan wani aiki da zai shafi ra'ayoyin Land Art. Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan umarnin za ta dace don fara wannan aiki?
answer_a: Tsara wani aiki a wajen makarantar na halitta wanda ke fuskantar canjin yanayi, kuma a haɗa su a matsayin abubuwa masu ma'ana na tsarin.
answer_b: Ku tsara wani aiki ta amfani da abubuwa na halitta daban-daban da aka samu kuma ku kirkiro shigarwa (installation) a cikin ɗakin wasanni na makaranta
answer_c: Ku tsara wani aiki ta amfani da sharar gari don shiga tsakani a cikin wani sarari na ciki na wurin"
answer_d: Tsara wani aiki ta hanyar fassara yanayin ƙasa daban-daban masu wakilta na wata ƙasa ta musamman da hotuna

question: Malami yana aiki da ajin makarantar tsakiya a kan darasin: “Jiki a matsayin madogara don tsari” kuma yana so ya kimanta manufar: “Yin gwaji da harsuna, dabaru, da salo daban-daban na ƙirƙirar fasaha da gani”. Waɗanne alamomi ne ya kamata su kasance a cikin jagorar da za ta tantance wannan manufa da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Zana zane-zanen wakiltar jigogi masu alaƙa da jiki a matsayin tallafi
answer_b: Gudanar da bincike na rubuce-rubuce (bibliographic) kan manufofi daban-daban da ke da alaƙa da jiki a matsayin tallafi
answer_c: Ana ƙirƙirar samfuri na farko ko samfurin tufafi wanda ke magance matsalar jiki a matsayin mai tallafi
answer_d: Yin bincike na fasaha game da yadda kayan suke don samar da samfurin sutura na farko

question: Malami yana aiki tare da ɗalibansa a kan ra'ayin gado mai taɓuwa kuma mai motsi. Domin sauƙaƙe fahimta, ya nuna musu hotuna daban-daban waɗanda ke misalta wannan ra'ayi. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya ƙunshi ingantaccen misali na gado mai taɓuwa kuma mai motsi?
answer_a: Hotunan wuraren shakatawa da na ajiyar yanayi
answer_b: Hotunan gidajen da aka ayyana su abubuwan tarihi na ƙasa
answer_c: Tasoshin ruwa daga wata al'ada ta dā
answer_d: Labarai da tatsuniyoyin gargajiya na baka

question:
Karanta yanayi mai zuwa:
Wani malami na ajin farko na Sakandire ƙarama yana shirin wani aiki inda ɗalibansa za su yi penta kai tsaye a waje, suna mai da Ƙungiyar Impressionist a matsayin abin dubawa.
Wace kwarewa ta baya, musamman dangane da dabarun fasahar hoto, ce ya wajaba ga waɗannan ɗalibai su mallaka?
answer_a: Amfani da dige-dige a gefe-gefe don samar da gaurayayyun launuka
answer_b: Amfani da launuka marasa kama da gaskiya ga abubuwa daban-daban na shimfiɗaɗɗen wuri
answer_c: Amfani da launin yanki a cikin sifofi a matsayin doron farko
answer_d: Amfani da baƙi launi don wakiltar inuwa

question: A karon farko, an ƙalubalanci ɗaliban ajin Shekara ta 1 na Ilimin Sakandare da su yi amfani da sassaka katako a matsayin hanyar bayyana ra'ayi. Don bayyana yadda wannan dabarar take, malamin ya yi amfani da wani misali daga rayuwar yau da kullum don yin kwatanci da tsarin yin zane-zane a kan katako. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya ƙunshi kwatancin da zai taimaka wajen bayyana yadda sassaka katako yake?
answer_a: Salo daga injin kwafi na makaranta
answer_b: Tambarin roba na sakatare a makaranta
answer_c: Tabbatar da ɗan yatsa a katin shaidar ɗalibai
answer_d: Alamar takalman ɗalibai a ƙasan aji

question:
Malam ya tsara kayan aikin tantancewa don tantance ƙirƙirar Stop Motion.
Wanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin ke nuna cewa ɗalibai suna gudanar da tsarin ƙirƙirar yadda ya kamata ta hanyar amfani da dabarun samarwa na musamman ga wannan fasaha?
answer_a: Yana zana zanukan abubuwa ko halaye, yana sanya su cikin labari ta amfani da zanen barkwanci
answer_b: Yana ɗaukan hotunan abubuwa ko mutane a jere ba tare da yankewa ba, yana sauya matsayinsu kaɗan.
answer_c: Yana ɗaukar fage daban-daban daga kusurwoyi iri-iri na sinima
answer_d: Sun gabatar da bidiyon su a tsarin dijital wanda aka yi shi da harbe-harben fim daban-daban

question: Bayanin halin da ake ciki: A fannin kiɗa, wata malamar makarantar yara ta shirya wani aiki don koyar da abubuwa daban-daban na kiɗa. Aikin farko ya ƙunshi sa yara su saurari sautin da ruwan famfo mai ɗigowa ke samarwa sannan su kwaikwayi shi ta hanyar tafi. Na gaba, dole ne su maimaita aikin ta hanyar sauraron ƙarar agogo. Wane abu na harshen kiɗa ne ake koyarwa da wannan aikin da aka yi?
answer_a: bugun jini
answer_b: lafazi
answer_c: Tsawon Lokaci
answer_d: Ƙarfi sosai

question: Wane aiki ne ke nuna mafi girman wahalar fasaha ga ɗalibin da ke koyon buga madannin lantarki?
answer_a: Waƙa da tushe kaɗawa
answer_b: Wasa da sirruka masu motsi
answer_c: Taka rallentando
answer_d: Buga arpeggio da hannun hagu

question:
Karanta wannan yanayi:
A aji na 5/6 na makarantar firamare, Malamin Kiɗa ya gayyaci ɗalibai su yi amfani da sararin ajin don su motsa yadda suka ga dama yayin da suke sauraron waƙar tafiya (march). An umarce su da su nuna bugun (pulse) da kuma tsananin ƙarar (accents) da za su iya gane su ta amfani da jikinsu. Bayan haka, a cikin ƙungiyoyi, sun amince a kan wani motsi don nuna tsananin ƙarar kiɗan: wanda zai iya zama durƙusawa, ɗaga hannu, da sauransu. Sun sake sauraron kiɗan kuma kowace ƙungiya ta yi motsin nata ɗaya bayan ɗaya don kowa ya yi wa juna kallo. Wane kayan aikin kimantawa ne ya kamata malamin ya yi amfani da shi don tabbatar da cewa ɗalibai suna iya bambanta abubuwan harshen kiɗa?
answer_a: Matsayi mai ma'ana
answer_b: Jerin abubuwan dubawa
answer_c: Rubutun labari-labari
answer_d: Sikeli na kimantawa

question:
Karanta yanayi na gaba:
Wata malama a aji na 5/6 ta tsara wata dabara ta matakai uku masu ci gaba, da nufin bunkasa a cikin dalibanta sauraren rarrabewa da kuma koyon karatu da rubutun kida.
1. Mataki na farko na dabarar ya kunshi zana zane-zane na kyauta wadanda ke ƙoƙarin wakiltar kayan kida da aka ji daga zaman sauraro da kuma shigarwar su.
3. Mataki na uku ya kunshi dalibai suna bin takardun kida masu sauki, tare da 'yan ma'auni da tsarin tsari mai sauki, ta hanyar ji.
Wace aiki za a iya bayar da shawara don mataki na biyu na wannan dabarar?
answer_a: Karatun taswirar kiɗa (chord chart)
answer_b: Karatun musicogram
answer_c: Kirkiri zubin tsari na yau da kullum
answer_d: Yi Zane na Venn

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Wani malami a aji na 6, a cikin sashen da ke kan bugun kiɗan Latin Amurka, yana so ya tattauna Manufar Koyo mai zuwa da ɗalibai: 'Don yin kiɗa ba tare da shiri ba da kuma ƙirƙirar kiɗa ta hanyar amfani da gogewa da ilimi bisa ga umarni da aka bayar.' Wanne daga cikin alamomin da ke gaba ne zai ba da damar tantance manufar da aka ambata?
answer_a: Suna yin salon raye-raye daidai da irin nau'in kiɗan da ake yi
answer_b: Suna fassara faifan kiɗa iri-iri na kayan aiki da na murya, bisa ga rubuce-rubucen waƙoƙi marasa daidaituwa.
answer_c: Suna kawo kiɗa da kayan kiɗan da suka ƙirƙira da kansu, bisa ga wani rubutun kiɗa
answer_d: Suna rakiyar jerin rithmu da bugun jiki, suna tsara tsarin rithmu da aka ba su yadda suka zaɓa

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: Wani malamin kiɗa a aji na shida, a cikin sashin "Kiɗan Sifonik", yana so ya gudanar da wani aiki wanda zai ba da damar cimma manufa mai biyo baya: "Don bayyanawa, tare da nuna ƙarin zurfafawa da cikakkun bayanai, jin dadi, motsin rai, da tunanin da kiɗan da aka saurara kuma aka yi ya gabatar, ta amfani da hanyoyin bayyanawa daban-daban (na magana, na jiki, na kiɗa, na gani)". Wane aiki ne ɗaliban suka gudanar wanda ya cimma wannan manufa ta sama?
answer_a: Kwaikwayi wasu fage daga wani shahararren fim a cikin aji bayan sauraron sautin waƙokinsa
answer_b: Wakiltar yanayin sauti bisa ga waka
answer_c: Shirya waƙoƙin raye-raye da za su nuna bambance-bambancen yanayi da aka fuskanta bayan sauraron wani yanki na kiɗa
answer_d: Ƙirƙiri gutsutsuren kiɗa da ke nuna zane (ko taswira) na jin daɗi ko motsin zuciya da fuskoki daban-daban na fim ke isarwa

question: Duba wannan yanayin: Wani malami a aji na bakwai yana son haɓaka koyo dangane da albarkatun furci, musamman sarrafa ƙarfin murya da lafazi. Wane ilimi na farko ya kamata ɗalibai su mallaka don cimma irin wannan koyon?
answer_a: Karatu mai sauti da amo
answer_b: Karatun waƙa
answer_c: Sifofin sauti
answer_d: Goyon bayan kayan kiɗa

question: Karanta wannan yanayi mai zuwa: Malam a ajin kiɗa na aji takwas yana shirya darasi a kan 'Hanyoyin Ci Gaban Kiɗa'. Wane ra'ayi ne ya kamata ɗalibai su riga su fahimta domin su iya fahimtar abubuwan da ke cikin darasin da aka shirya?
answer_a: Bambanci
answer_b: Tushewa
answer_c: Jigon waka
answer_d: Ci gaban sauti mai daɗi

question:
Karanta lamarin da ke biyo baya:
Wani malami a aji 8, a cikin sashin darasi mai taken "Manyan Mawallafa," yana so ɗalibansa su haɓaka sauraro mai zurfi ta hanyar ayyukan Ludwig van Beethoven. Saboda haka, dole ne su gudanar da wani aiki wanda ya haɗa kiɗa da furci na jiki.
Wanne kayan aiki ne ya fi dacewa don tantance matakan samun nasara a fannin bayyanawa, fassara, da ƙirƙira a cikin duka fannoni biyu da kuma daidaitawar furci a tsakaninsu?
answer_a: Faifai mai ɗauke da takardu
answer_b: Ma'aunin tantancewa
answer_c: Jerin Abubuwan Dubawa
answer_d: Sikeli na kimantawa

question: Wani malami ya yi aiki tare da ɗalibai a aji na 5 kan iyawar waƙa ta hanyar karanta rubutun kiɗa mai sauƙi (simple score). Bayan shekaru uku, malamin ya dawo ya koyar da wannan rukunin ɗaliban, waɗanda yanzu suke aji na 8, kuma yana da niyyar yin aiki a kan abun ciki da fasaha iri ɗaya: waƙa ta hanyar karanta rubutun kiɗa (score). Wane irin ka'idar fasahar koyarwa (methodological principle) dangane da fannin harshen kiɗa (musical language) malamin yake amfani da ita?
answer_a: Haɗaɗɗiya: don samar da koyo, dole ne a haɗa wani ɓangare na kiɗa mai zurfin tunani da wata fasaha
answer_b: Rarrabuwa: an raba wani abu na kiɗa na bai-ɗaya zuwa ƙananan sassa waɗanda ake aiki a kansu mataki-mataki
answer_c: Maimaituwa: ana sake gabatar da sashi guda ɗaya na harshen kiɗa a matakai masu ƙaruwa na rikitarwa
answer_d: Maimaitawa: Dole ne a yi aiki a kan sashi na kiɗa guda ɗaya sau da yawa, da farko ta hanyar kwaikwayo sannan kuma karatu

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: A wata ziyara ta ilimi zuwa gidan adana kayan tarihi na waje (open-air museum), wata rukuni ta ɗaliban aji shida sun ziyarci zanen bangon (murals) tare da jagororinsu da malamansu. Daga nan, a cikin darasi na gaba, malamin ya nemi su zana zanen bangon da ya fi ɗaukar hankalinsu saboda abubuwan harshe na gani (elements of visual language) da manufofin bayyanawa (expressive purposes). A ƙarshen darasin, malamin ya tattara zane-zanen don nazari. Bisa ga zane-zanen da ɗaliban suka yi, wace dabara (strategy) malamin zai iya amfani da ita don jagorantar ɗaliban a cikin nazarin zanen bangon?
answer_a: Nuna zane-zanen ɗalibai kuma samar da tattaunawa ta rukuni a kan harshe na gani da manufofin bayyanawa da ɗaliban suka gano
answer_b: Ku tambayi ɗalibai tambayoyi game da manufofin harshe na gani (visual language) da manufa mai fa'ida (expressive purpose) a cikin zane-zanen bango (muralism), wanda zai haifar da tattaunawa ta rukuni
answer_c: Ku yi gabatarwa ta amfani da zane-zane daga mashahuran masu fasaha game da zanen bango (muralism) sannan ku shiga tattaunawa don gane darajar bayyanawa ta yaren gani
answer_d: Nuna wasu hotunan zanen bango da aka ziyarta kuma ku yi wa ɗalibai bayanin alaƙar dake tsakanin ra'ayoyin, harshen gani, da mahallin da aka sa su a ciki

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: A cikin aji na mataki na shida, a cikin tsarin sashin darasi mai taken 'Muhallin fasaha: fasahar zamani', malamar ta gabatar da manufa mai zuwa ga ɗalibanta: 'Ƙirƙiri wani zane-zane na abubuwa bisa ga fahimtar darajar bayyanannun kyau na zamani'. Wacece daga cikin dabarun tsara hanya za ta ba da damar cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Bincike game da zanen abu na ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da aka ambata; ƙirƙirar zane mai maimaita na aikin mai zane da aka yi nazari da shi ta hanyar fenti na acrylic
answer_b: Binciki ayyukan zanen abubuwa; ƙirƙiri zanen abu ta amfani da wani abu da ka ceto daga muhallinka na yau da kullun
answer_c: Lura da ayyukan zanen abubuwa (ko zanen sura); gano manyan halayensu don wani aiki
answer_d: Bayyana ayyukan zane-zane masu kama da abubuwa kuma kwatanta jigoginsu da abubuwan yaren gani

question: Ka karanta halin da ke gaba: A cikin ajin Shekara ta 6, a cikin sashin 'Ƙirƙirar gani, mutum da yanayi', Malamin yana neman cimma manufa mai zuwa: 'Ƙirƙiri aikin hoto bisa tunanin ɗalibai na kansu, ta amfani da kayan ɗorewa.' Wace ce daga cikin ayyukan da ke biye ce za ta bada damar yin aiki wajen cimma manufar da Malamin ya kafa?
answer_a: Ƙirƙiri wani zane-zane kore wanda yake nuna ɗanɗanonka na kanka
answer_b: Ka yi wani sassaƙe na itace da ke wakiltar halayenka mafi muhimmanci na kanka
answer_c: Gina sassaka da papye-mashe dangane da manufar gurɓacewa
answer_d: Ka tsara wani fasta da kayan da aka sake amfani da su wanda ke tallata sake amfani da su a makaranta

question: Karanta wannan yanayi: Wata malama mai koyar da ajin ɗalibai na aji na 6 tana koyar da dabarar sassaka itace (xylography). Ta nuna musu misalai daban-daban kuma ta yi bayanin yadda ake sassaka da buga hoto ga ɗalibanta. Da wannan ilimin, ta umarce su su zana wani zane na farko da za a yi a ƙarƙashin halayen wannan dabarar sassakawa. Lokacin da ta fara zagayawa a cikin aji don lura da ci gaban ɗaliban, sai ta gane cewa wasu daga cikin zane-zanen suna ɗauke da kalmomi. Malamar ta dakatar da darasin, ta ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan zane-zanen a matsayin misali, sannan ta yi bayanin abin da zai faru yayin bugawa idan aka sassaka kalmar a jikin katakon bugu kamar yadda take a zane. Wace dabarar koyarwa ce za ta shiryar da ɗaliban don su ƙirƙiri siffar bugu yadda ya kamata?
answer_a: Fassara zane zuwa ga jigo da takardar karfe
answer_b: Ku nuna bugun wani zane-zanen katako (xylograph) don bayyana sakamakon sassakar.
answer_c: Ajiye madubi a kan zane don a ga hoton a juye
answer_d: Zana harafi a allo don bayyana fage-fage daban-daban a cikin ƙirƙirar zurfi

question: A ajin aji na shida, a farkon sashin "Zane na Sassaka," malamin ya gabatar da wannan aiki ga ɗalibai a darasi na farko: ku yi tunanin sassakakku kuma ku zana su a littafin zanen ku. Bayan haka, ya umarce su su kawo kayayyaki kamar su manne, wani tushe, yadudduka da aka sake yin amfani da su, da nau'ukan laushi na halitta da na roba daban-daban don darasi na gaba. A darasi na biyu, ta hanyar aikin rukuni, ɗalibai za su gina tsarin zane tare da kayan da aka nema, don kawo tunaninsu a aikace. Wane mataki ne na tsarin sassauci na ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire darasi na biyu ya yi daidai da shi?
answer_a: Gwaji
answer_b: Tsari
answer_c: Gabatar da rabawa
answer_d: Ka yi tunani kuma ka samar da dabaru

question: Karanta yanayi mai zuwa: Dalibai na aji na shida sun fara darasi da aka yi niyya don "Inganta godiyar kyawun fasahar ayyukan gani." Don yin haka, suna aiki biyu-biyu, suna ziyartar shafukan yanar gizo daban-daban na gidajen adana kayan fasaha na zamani a Intanet, suna zaɓar wani aiki kuma suna neman bayani game da shi. Domin jagorantar binciken, malamin ya ba su jerin ayyuka da aka tsara cikin matakai uku. Wanne daga cikin jerin nan mai zuwa zai ba da damar cimma manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Bayyana hoton; gano abubuwan harshen gani; nazarta siffarsa da abin cikinsa
answer_b: yi tunani a kan sura da abin da ke cikinta; yi nazarin abubuwan harshen gani; kwatanta hoton
answer_c: Bayyana tsari da abun ciki na hoton, yi la'akari da abubuwan harshen gani; san tarihin rayuwar mai zanen
answer_d: San tarihin rayuwar mai fasaha; nazarta fasalinsa da abun ciki; gano abubuwan yaren gani

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Wata malama ta Ajin Takwas ta fara sashe mai taken Ƙirƙirar gani, mutum da muhalli. A cikin ajin, dalibai sun koyi game da motsin fasahar ƙasa ta hanyar shahararrun ayyuka, sannan sun rarraba kansu zuwa ƙungiyoyi don ƙirƙirar wani aiki dangane da wannan motsin fasaha. Bisa ga abin da aka bayyana a sama, wane jerin ayyuka ne zai fi dacewa don cimma manufar wannan sashe?
answer_a: Yi rikodi na abubuwan yanayi, kuma ka samar da juzu'i da su
answer_b: Ka lura da nassoshi daga ƙungiyar fasaha sannan ka ƙirƙiri zane daga gare su
answer_c: Shirya amfani da haduwa da abubuwan halitta da kuma yin aiki da su a wani wuri
answer_d: yi nazarin tsarin ɗora abubuwa tare da abubuwa na halitta da kuma tantance dacewarsu don ƙirƙirar wani abu

question: Karanta halin da ke gaba: A cikin ajin makarantar firamare na aji na 6, a cikin sashen "Buga Zane", wani malami yana so ɗalibansa su ƙirƙiri hotunan kwafi ɗaya (monotypes). Wane ilimin da suka koya a baya ya kamata ɗalibai su samu idan suna son ci gaba a aikin ƙirƙirar hotunan kwafi ɗaya?
answer_a:
system
Aiwatarwa da Emulshinarwa na raga
answer_b: Kirkira da gudanar da jerin ayyuka
answer_c: Amfani da bayyana ma'ana ta hanyar layi mai laushi
answer_d: Rika da kirkirar yanke-yanke da kayan aiki daban-daban

question: Karanta yanayi mai zuwa: A ajin 8, a cikin tsarin darasin "Ƙirƙirar gani, mutum da muhalli", ɗalibai suna gudanar da wani aikin bidiyo-sauti na rukuni game da gurbatar muhalli a cikin al'ummarsu. Don fara gyaran bidiyon, malamin yana buƙatar tabbatar sun kammala ayyukan da suka gabata, kamar su ƙirƙirar taswirar labari (storyboard), ɗaukar gajerun bidiyoyi a cikin al'umma akan batun, da kuma rubuta rubuce-rubucen da suka shafi bidiyon, waɗanda za a haɗa su a aikin bidiyo-sauti nasu. Wane daga cikin kayan aikin tantancewa ne ya dace don tabbatar da kammala waɗannan ayyukan?
answer_a: Fannin aiki da aka yi
answer_b: Jerin abubuwan dubawa
answer_c: Kallon shata na auna inganci ta faka-faka
answer_d:
Bincike bisa ga labari/rahoton mutum ɗaya
Rahoton da aka samu daga mutum guda
Rubutaccen tarihin wani abu da mutum ya ba da shaida a kai
Binciken da aka samu daga labarin mutum ɗaya

question: A cikin aji na 8, a ƙarƙashin tsarin darasin "Tsari da Yanayi," malamin ya gabatar da manufar nan: "Ƙirƙiri zane-zane na abubuwa waɗanda ke nuna wahayi daga yanayi." Daga cikin ayyukan kimantawa masu zuwa, wanne ne zai baiwa malamin damar tabbatar da cimma manufar?
answer_a: Lura da alakar da ke tsakanin tsuntsu da jirgin sama, sannan ka tsara wani zane-mai-bayani (infographic) da ke bayyana alakar siffa da tsarin gine-gine a tsakaninsu
answer_b: Lura da abubuwan halitta da ke da kamanni, kuma ka tsara gabatarwa da ke nuna alaƙa kai tsaye da abubuwan tsari
answer_c: Kalli abubuwan ƙira waɗanda yanayi ya yi musu wahayi, kuma tsara jerin lokaci da ke nuna sauye-sauyen da ya samu tun daga farawarsa har zuwa yau
answer_d: Kula da alakar dake tsakanin kayan ƙira da yanayi, sannan ka ƙirƙiri wani abu da yake kwaikwayon siffa ko tsarin wani abu na yanayi

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: A cikin aji na biyar, wanda aka san su da samun sakamako masu kyau a aikin rukuni na waje da ajujuwa, malamin yana so ya tsara wata dabarar koyarwa wadda za ta cimma manufar “Ƙirƙira cikin Girma”. Wacece daga cikin dabarun koyarwa masu zuwa ce ta fi dacewa da matakin koyarwa da kuma yanayin ɗaliban?
answer_a: Lura da muhallin halitta, ku yi zane-zane tare don ƙirƙirar wani sassake bisa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan abubuwan, kuma ku yi wa wani gujeren laka ƙirar siffa
answer_b: Lura da tsarin gine-ginen yankin da ke kusa, ku yi tsare-tsare, kuma ku gina wakilci mai girma uku daidai ma'auni a aikin rukuni
answer_c: Kalli hotunan zanukan masu salon impressionism, nazarta zurfin matakansu kuma ka sake kirkirar su a siffar agajin gini (relief), ta hanyar aikin hadin gwiwa
answer_d: Kula da muhallinsu na yau da kullum, zaɓi wani abu, sai a sake tsara shi bisa ga sabbin buƙatu da aka gano tare da abokan ajinsu

question: Ka karanta yanayin da ke gaba: A cikin ajin kiɗa na shekara ta biyu ta sakandire, a sashin kiɗan symphony, wata rukuni ta ɗalibai tana sauraron Bolero na Ravel. Malamin ya jagoranci sauraron zuwa hanyoyi daban-daban na tsara kayan kiɗan jigon da yake ginawa. Wane aiki ne ya fi dacewa ga ɗalibai su samar da tunani mai zurfi kan aikin da aka saurara?
answer_a: Yi nazarin guntun waƙar da aka gina waƙar a kai
answer_b: Binciko tasirin bayyanawa da aka samar a wannan aiki daga bangaren launi na sauti
answer_c: Danganta tsarin haɗawa da lokacin tarihi da ya faru
answer_d: Bambance kayan aiki da ke shiga cikin aikin da kuma shigarwar su

question:
Karanta wannan yanayin:
Domin su koyi da yin gwaji da kayan aikin canza sauti na dijital, Malamin Kiɗa ya umurci ɗaliban Shekara ta Biyu su yi rikodin karatun waƙa. Sannan ya umarce su da su:

answer_c: Jerin abubuwan dubawa
answer_d: Sikeli na kimantawa

question: Karanta halin da ke tafe: Daliban shekara ta uku a makarantar sakandare suna shirya gabatarwa ta kiɗa don Taron Waƙoƙin Bazara da makarantarsu ke gudanarwa. Malaminsu yana sanya ido kan ɗaliban a lokacin atisaye 10 da ake da su kuma yana bin diddigin ci gabansu, yana la'akari da halayensu da kuma iyawarsu ta fuskantar aikin da kuma ci gaban fasahohin kiɗa na fassara. question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: A ajin Kiɗa na Makarantar Tsakiya, wani malami yana son ya tantance ɗalibai ɗaiɗai dangane da ƙwarewarsu ta karatu da rubutu na kiɗa. Don yin haka, kowane ɗalibi zai karɓi takardar rubutun kiɗa da ke ɗauke da gajeruwar waƙa mai sauƙi wadda ba su taɓa sani ba. answer_a: Fayil ɗin Aiki

answer_d: Ma'aunin ƙima

question: Karanta halin da ke tafe: A ajin dalibai na shekara ta biyu, malamin yana son koyar da aikin gyarawa (molding) a sassaka. answer_a: Shirya jelatin
answer_b: Cika kwalba da ruwa
answer_c: Saƙa ƙasa a cikin tukunyar fure
answer_d: A cire goro daga bawonsa

question: Karanta yanayi mai zuwa: A wata makarantar sakandare ta ƙasa, wani malami yana so ya yi aiki tare da ɗalibai a kan tsarin birane ta hanyar magance bambance-bambancen bayyanar gani a sararin samaniya na jama'ar makarantar. Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ne ya dace don aiki a kan tsarin birane tare da ɗaliban, bisa ga abin da aka bayyana a baya?
answer_a: Zana fasalin makarantar daga waje
answer_b: Ka tsara wani fasto wanda ke tallata kula da amfani mai kyau na kayan daki na birni
answer_c: Gyarawa ɗaki a daidaita shi da dandano da buƙatun mutum
answer_d: Ƙirƙirar alamomi bisa ga lura da buƙatun makarantar

question: Karanta halin da ke gaba: A cikin ajin shekara ta 12, a cikin sashin 'Binciko Harsunan Fasaha na Zamaninmu', wata malama tana so ta yi wa ɗalibanta bayani, ta hanyar wani aiki, tsarin ƙirƙirar sitensil. Wanne ne daga zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya ƙunshi aikin da zai ba da damar bayyana wannan tsarin?
answer_a: A sassaƙa a kan kuɗi da burin sannan a buga shi
answer_b: Shafe tsabar kuɗi ka buga shi a kan takarda
answer_c: A shafa fensir a kan takarda da aka dora a kan kuɗi
answer_d: Ajiye kuɗin nan a kan takarda ka kuma zana a gefen sa

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Wani malami tare da ɗalibansa na shekara ta farko a sakandare, a ƙarshen sashin 'Zanen Bango', yana so ɗalibansa su yi wa kansu kimantawa na wannan manufa: 'Su kimanta zane-zanen bangon su, suna la'akari da alaƙar da ke tsakanin manufa ta bayyanawa, kayan aiki, da kuma harshen gani'. Wace aiki ce za ta ba da damar auna cimma manufar da aka ambata?
answer_a: Suna gamsuwa da abubuwan yaren gani da aka yi amfani da su a ayyukan zanen bangonsu
answer_b: Suna nazarin zanukansu na bango suna la'akari da jigo, kayan aiki masu dorewa, launi, siffa, da layukan da aka zana a cikin tsarin
answer_c: Suna gwaji da nau'o'in kayayyaki daban-daban dangane da maudu'in aikin
answer_d: Suna kafa dangantaka tsakanin yanayin abubuwan dorewa na aikin da siffofi, layuka, launuka, da taba-jiki da aka gabatar

question: A ajin kiɗa na aji na 7, malamin yana koyar da wani "quodlibet" mai sassa uku. Da zarar an koyar da waƙoƙin uku ga dukan ajin, malamin ya raba su zuwa ƙungiyoyi uku, inda ya ba kowace ƙungiya waƙa ɗaya. Da aka fara haɗa waƙoƙin tare, dole malamin ya dakatar da aikin saboda ɗaya daga cikin ƙungiyoyin ya fara sauri fiye da sauran, kuma quodlibet ɗin ya lalace. Wane shiga tsakani ne mafi kyau daga malamin don warware wannan matsalar?
answer_a: Kowace ƙungiya za ta yi waƙarta don sauran ƙungiyoyi su saurara kuma su fahimci sassa daban-daban na kowace a cikin aikin Quodlibet ɗin.
answer_b: Za a yi waƙar tare, amma dole kowace ƙungiya ta mai da hankali a kan muryarta don ta fahimci nata ɓangare yadda ya kamata, don kada wata ƙungiya ta yi gaggawar shigowa a lokutan shigar quodlibet.
answer_c: Ƙungiyoyin da ba su yi gaba ba a cikin shigewar, za su rera waƙoƙinsu da aka ɗora a juna, don haka ƙungiyar da ta yi gaba za ta iya sauraren aikin quodlibet sosai, yayin da take buga kari
answer_d: Ajin za su saurari misalai na quodlibet don mai da hankali kan waƙa ɗaya sannan wata. Manufar ita ce su fahimci dogaro da juna na muryoyin da kuma muhimmancin kiyaye bugun lokaci mai daidaituwa.

question: A cikin aji na mataki na 8, a cikin sashin “Bayyanawa da ingantawa”, an tambayi ɗalibai su ƙirƙiri kiɗa ta hanyar amfani da abubuwa daban-daban na harshen kiɗa. Don wannan dalili, malamin zai gudanar da aikin gwaji na farko da kuma ƙirƙira, don haka daga baya kowane rukuni zai iya samun ra'ayoyi don ƙirƙirar kiɗan su. Wace hanya ce ta koyarwa za ta fi dacewa don magance aikin gwaji na farko da kuma ƙirƙira?
answer_a: Malamin zai bayar da dogo na kiɗa, inda sassa daban-daban na harshen kiɗa za su bayyana, waɗanda za a iya amfani da su don ƙirƙirar waƙoƙi. Ta wannan hanya, ƙungiyoyin za su sami albarkatu don abubuwan da za su ƙirƙira.
answer_b: Malami zai gudanar da zaman kirkira. Don wannan aiki, za a jawo siffofin tsara kiɗa daga cikin hula. Idan wata musamman ta bayyana, za su bayyana irin abubuwan harshen kiɗa da za a iya amfani da su don fitar da sautin wannan siffa.
answer_c: Malamin zai bayar da kubus huɗu don mirginawa. A kowace fuskarsa, kubus na farko zai wakilci “ƙarfi da laushi”; na biyu, “sifofi”; na uku, “salolin kiɗa”; na huɗu, “agogik”. Kowace rukuni za ta yi ƙirƙirar kiɗa da abubuwan da suka samu lokacin da suka mirgina kowace kubus.
answer_d: Malamin zai bayar da wasan kafa-kafa na kiɗa. Za a iya kammala shi yayin da suke sauraron kayan aikin haɗa kiɗa iri daban-daban waɗanda malamin zai kunna. Da zarar an kammala wasan kafa-kafan, ƙungiyoyin za su sami abubuwa daban-daban da za su taimaka musu su ƙera kiɗansu.

question: Malami, a ajin Firamare na biyar, yana mai da hankali kan Jigon Saurara da Jin Daɗi, yana gudanar da azuzuwa masu yawa, waɗanda za su ƙare da aikin kimantawa da aka ba maki don kimanta manufar “Bayyana ji, motsin rai, da ra'ayoyin da kiɗa ya bayar.” Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan manuniyan kimantawa ya nuna manufar koyo da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Suna gabatar wa al'umma ayyukan da aka yi a lokacin kwas ɗin
answer_b: Suna bayyana kansu ta jiki yayin da suke sauraron waƙoƙin kiɗa da na murya
answer_c: Suna nuna sauƙin halitta a cikin gabatarwarsu ta kaɗe-kaɗe guda ɗaya da kuma na haɗin kai
answer_d: Suna rera waka da kiɗa na asali daban-daban, suna mai da hankali kan ingancin sautin gabatarwarsu

question: Malami/malama na ajin takwas yana/tana koyar da ɗalibi/ɗaliba darussansa/ta na farko a kan madanni. Sun daɗe suna yin atisaye kan yadda za a zauna, yadda za a ajiye yatsu, da kuma yadda za a yi amfani da feda ta dama. Malami/malama ya/ta yi mu'amala ta hanyar koyarwa daban-daban a lokuta daban-daban da ɗalibin/ɗalibar, dangane da yadda ɗalibin/ɗalibar ke taka rawa da kayan aikin. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya nuna misali na martani mai ginawa (formative feedback) da malami/malama ya/ta ba wa ɗalibin/ɗalibar game da aikinsa/ta?
answer_a: Taya murna, gaba ɗaya yana da kyau sosai. Kana da murya mai kyau, amma mun san za ka iya yin abin da ya fi haka
answer_b: Ka tuna cewa yatsun sikeli 1-2-3-1-2-3-4-5 ne, kuma hannaye su kasance a madaidaiciya da jiki.
answer_c: Kada ka manta cire ƙafarka daga falal ɗin dama a lokacin da faifan kiɗan ya nuna, domin kada wani tarin jituwa ya samu ba zato ba tsammani
answer_d: Matsayin hannaye ya yi daidai. Yanzu abin da ya rage shi ne a gwada yatsa don cimma waƙar da ka zaɓa

question: A cikin aji na 7, lokacin kimanta aikin rukuni da ya shafi zaman kaɗe-kaɗe wanda manufarsa ita ce "A yi polyrhythm a ma'aunin lokaci 6/8", wani malami ya shirya dalibai su fara aikin. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ya nuna samun ilimin da ake tsammani?
answer_a: Shigar da polymeters a cikin ma'aunin ternary mai haɗawa
answer_b: daukar ma'aunin biyu-biyu da uku-uku a madadi

system

answer_d: Shiruwa da mabanbantan heterometries a ma'aunan biyu-biyu da uku-uku

question: A cikin ajin Aji na 8, malami zai gabatar wa ɗalibai yadda za su yi amfani da ƙarfin sauti (dynamics) daban-daban a cikin rubutun kiɗan da suke yi. Wace daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ce ya kamata ɗaliban sun kammala tun da fari domin magance abin da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Gane alamomin gudun kiɗa
answer_b: Karatun jumloli mai alaƙa da furuci
answer_c: Aiwatar da ritardando, accelerando, da rubato
answer_d: Binciken sautin na ƙarfin kayan kiɗan

question: A cikin kimantawa ta jimla a aji na 8, a lokacin zama na aiwatar da kayan kida gaba ɗaya, manufar ita ce: “Ƙirƙira da kuma gabatar da waka mai tsarin baitoci,” malami yana shirya ɗaliban don su gabatar da abubuwan da suka ƙirƙira. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan manuniyan kimantawa ne ke nuna cimma manufar?
answer_a: Suna yin waƙa inda ake maimaita rawa da bambance-bambance iri-iri
answer_b: Suna kirkirar waka inda aka maimaita kida daya da kalmomi daban-daban
answer_c: Suna ƙirƙirar waƙa inda sabon jigo mai bambanci ke biyo bayan babban jigon.
answer_d: Suna yin waƙa inda aka saka koda ko sashin ƙarshe a ƙarshen jigon waƙar

question: Malamin aji na shida, yayin darasi akan ma’aunin waƙa, zai fara bayyana abubuwan da suka shafi rabon juzu’i uku-uku na raka’ar ma’auni. Waɗanne abubuwa ne ya kamata ɗalibai su riga sun sani domin su samu nasarar fahimtar wannan sabon darasi?
answer_a: Bugun zuciya da lafazi
answer_b: Yanayin rithim
answer_c: Rabuwar-biyu
answer_d: Ma'aunin biyu da uku

question: A cikin sashin "Fassarar Wakokin Birane", wani malami ya roƙi mai kaɗa bass na darasin da ya sauya wani rubutun kiɗa (score) don kayan kiɗansa, wanda asalinsa an rubuta shi don gita. Wane sanin farko ne ɗalibin dole ya mallaka domin ya yi canjin rubutun kiɗan da aka nema?
answer_a: Karatun nuni na ma'aunin babban sauti (bass clef)
answer_b: Karatun makullin sauti mai tsayi
answer_c: Karanta ma'ajin Amurka
answer_d: Karatun tablature na bass

question: A cikin aji na bakwai, wani malami yana fara darasin “Halitta Cikin Girma”, da nufin cimma burin “Kirkirar ayyukan gani daga sha’awoyi na kai, ta hanyar gwaji da kayan aiki masu dorewa a fannin sassaƙa.” A darasi na farko, malamin yana so ɗaliban su fahimci mahimmancin hanyoyin gina tsari mai girma ta amfani da kayan aiki masu dorewa. Menene kayan koyarwa mafi dacewa don cimma fahimtar ɗalibai game da waɗannan hanyoyin?
answer_a: Bidiyo na tarin-tarin da aka yi da kayan amfani daban-daban da aka sake amfani da su
answer_b: Shigar da hotuna na zane-zanen sassaka da aka yi da kayan sake amfani da su ta hanyar dijital
answer_c: Jagora da tsarin ƙirƙirar sassaka da kayan da aka sake amfani da su
answer_d: Tabbataccen hoton aikin gini mai girma uku da aka yi da kayan da aka sake amfani da su

question: A cikin darasin “Sassaka da Wakilan Jinsi”, a ajin ɗaliban aji na bakwai, malami yana gudanar da kimantawa ta ci gaba a lokacin gina aikin hoton fuska. A cikin kimantarwar, malamin ya lura cewa ɗalibai suna nuna rudani game da abin da bayyana motsin rai da amfani da motsin jiki ke nufi wajen siffanta halin mutum. Wane aiki ne daga cikin waɗannan da ke gabatar da dabarar da ta fi dacewa don magance waɗannan wahalhalun koyo da aka nuna?
answer_a: Gano kurakurai a cikin wakilcin fuskoki a cikin shawarwarin ɗalibai kuma ka tambaye su dalilin faruwarsu
answer_b: Bada matsalolin da aka gano game da furuci a cikin hotunan mutane da kuma bayyana shugabannin tantancewa tare da matakan tantancewa
answer_c: Gudanar da baje-koli na tushe masu alaƙa da faɗar ji, tare da nazarin abubuwan da ke gabatar da wahala a cikin zane-zanen fitattun masu fasaha.
answer_d: Bayyana manufofin nazari na sashin da suka shafi abubuwan bayyanawa a cikin sassaƙa, kuma gyara ma'aunan kimantawa waɗanda ke haifar da matsala mafi girma ga ɗalibai

question: A cikin sashin "Kirkirar gani, mutum da yanayi", a aji na 8, wata malama ta sanya manufar "Ƙirƙirar ayyukan gani bisa ga yabawa da nazarin bayyanar kyau da suka shafi dangantakar dake tsakanin mutane, yanayi da muhalli." A matsayin tantancewar farko, malamar ta nemi ɗaliban su zaɓi wani aiki daga tarihin zane-zane wanda ke nuna dangantakar da aka ambata. Bayan ta duba ayyukan, ta fahimci cewa ɗaliban suna da iyakantaccen tunani game da abin da aka nema, domin hotunan da suka zaɓa sun shafi manyan shimfiɗar yanayi kawai. Wace dabara malamar za ta iya amfani da ita don faɗaɗa tunanin ɗaliban?
answer_a: Zaɓi ayyukan tunani, nuna su a cikin aji, kuma ba da shawarar cewa ɗalibai su ƙirƙiri zane-zane mai la'akari da sauyin yanayi
answer_b: Bawa kowane ɗalibi aikin tunani, sa su rushe shi ta hanyar haɗa hotuna, sannan ku tantance sakamakon.
answer_c: Ku ba kowane ɗalibi aikin tunani, ku shirya tunani kan sauyin yanayi, kuma ku sa su yi wani shiri na kirkire-kirkire a kan batun
answer_d: Bayyana litattafan ishara, sa a gaba cewa ɗalibai su zaɓi wani aiki, kuma a jagoranci wani nazari mai zurfi wanda zai kafa alaƙa tsakanin aikin da aka zaɓa da kuma wata ƙalubale ta muhalli

question: A cikin aji na bakwai (7), a lokacin ci gaban darasin "Ƙirƙira shaida al'ada a fili," malamar tana mai da hankali kan manufar "Aiwatar da abubuwa da ka'idojin harshen gani don sadar da shaida al'ada." Don cimma wannan, ta ba wa ɗaliban shawarar su gudanar da wani aiki, inda ta hanyar kwaleji (collage), za su tsara sararin ɗakinsu. Malamar za ta tantance waɗannan kayan ƙira ta hanyar rumbut (rubric). Wace ce daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba za ta fi nuna nasarar samun wannan ilimi?
answer_a: Suna dacewa da sassakewar zaɓaɓɓun wurare gwargwadon yadda suke so don yin tasiri a cikin ɗakin
answer_b: Suna haɗa kundin samfuri na ƙirarorin takardar bango daban-daban don yi wa ganuwar ɗakin ado
answer_c: Suna amfani da dorawa guntayen hotunan abubuwa a kan juna don tsara sararin ɗakin
answer_d: Suna amfani da hanyoyin yanka da liƙawa don rufe bangarori daban-daban da suke samar da saman ɗakin

question: Malamar ajin aji na takwas tana cikin matsakaicin ajin darasin "Kafawa da Fasahar Zamani," inda ɗalibai ke aiki a kan ayyukansu na fasaha da suka shafi manufar "Ƙirƙirar kafa bidiyo bisa jigon tarihin kai." Ɗalibai suna a matakin tsara shawarwarinsu, wanda malamar za ta tantance bisa ga jagora. Wane mai nuni (indicator) malamar za ta iya amfani da shi a cikin jagorar don tantance tsarin ayyukan ɗaliban?
answer_a: Suna ɗauka, zaɓar ra'ayoyi, da gyara kayan gani-da-sauraro
answer_b: Suna kafa dangantaka tsakanin manufar bayyanawa da ke cikin aikinsu da kuma ta abokan aikinsu
answer_c: Sun shirya na'urar bidiyon su, suna la'akari da yanayin sararin da take ciki da kuma yadda take mu'amala da bidiyon
answer_d: Suna bayyana matakan aiki da za su yi amfani da su, suna la'akari da dabarun, kayan aiki, hanyoyin bi, da kuma mu'amala da masu kallo

question:
