yi nazarin ayyukan takwarorinsu kuma su bayyana ra'ayoyinsu
yi nazarin ayyukan takwarorinsu kuma su bayyana ra'ayoyinsu
answer_b: Ku yi zanuka bisa ga wani ra'ayi da aka gabatar kuma ku nuna su ga ajin
answer_c: Zab'i jigon da ake ciki a halin yanzu kuma ka wakilce shi ta hanyar motsin jiki
answer_d: Siffanta wani tunani ta amfani da kayan da ba na al'ada ba da suke da su a hannunsu

question: Malami na shekara ta huɗu na ilimin sakandire yana aiki a kan sashin nan "Kayayyakin Fasaha a cikin Muhallinmu na Kiɗa". Ɗaya daga cikin manufofin da aka ƙayyade a cikin tsarinsa shine ɗalibai su san kuma su gane tasirin sauti daban-daban waɗanda ake amfani da su ga murya da kayan kiɗa (reverb, delay, da sauransu). Wace ce daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ce take gabatar da kayan aiki da ke da damammakin ilimi mafi girma bisa ga manufar koyo da malamin ya tsara?
answer_a: Pedal mai ci gaba (ko: Pedal mai riƙe sauti)
answer_b: Na'urar MIDI
answer_c: Software mai gyara sauti
answer_d: Zaɓaɓɓun waƙoƙin sauti na kiɗa

question: A cikin ajin sakandare na shekara ta uku, a cikin sashin "Ƙungiyar Kiɗan Kayan Aiki," malam ya shirya darasi da nufin cewa ɗalibai su tsara dokokinsu na kansu don haɗa kiɗa. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan jerin ayyuka da ɗalibai za su gudanar ya fi dacewa don cimma manufar da malamin ya kafa?
answer_a: Suna fitar da tunanin tsare-tsare masu rhythm, suna gano halayensu na ma'auni, kuma suna ɗora waƙoƙi da haɗin kai, suna zaɓar waɗanda suka fi dacewa da tsarin rhythmic. Daga baya, sai su haɗa guntun waƙar, su gyara kurakurai, kuma su gabatar da aikinsu ga takwarorinsu, waɗanda ke yin tsokaci a kan sakamakon ƙarshe
answer_b: Suna gabatar da ra'ayoyinsu ɗaiɗai ga sauran ajin. Sai su zaɓi ra'ayin da ya fi wakiltar ajin da kuma sha'awarsu ta kiɗa. Sa'an nan kuma su yi atisaye su rera shi a matsayin rukuni. Daga baya, sai su binciki sakamakon ta hanyar ingantawa don gabatarwa ta ƙarshe.
answer_c: Suna haifar da ƙalubale kuma suna samar da ra'ayoyi na farko da ke ba su damar mai da hankali da tsara ci gaba da aikin. Daga baya, suna gudanar da gwaji da bincike na sauti a matsayin shawara ta farko, wadda suke dubawa, ingantawa, da kuma rabawa a kusa da martani daga takwarori da malami
answer_d: Suna sauraron wani yanki da malami ya zaɓa, suna nazarin abubuwan da ke gina tsari na asali. Suna yin atisaye a kan sassa daban-daban a kan kayan kaɗe-kaɗensu, kuma suna gabatar da wannan yanki, wanda daga baya suke amfani da shi don ƙirƙirar nasu sigar, suna mutunta tsarin na asali na samfurin da aka gabatar.

question: Wani malami a ajin sakandire na shekara ta biyu yana shirin yin aiki tare da ɗalibai kan rarrabewar tsare-tsare ta ji a cikin waƙoƙin da suka shahara. Don yin haka, a lokacin wasu darussa, ɗalibai za su saurari zaɓaɓɓun waƙoƙi kuma su rubuta sassa daban-daban na kowacce (kamar baiti, koro, rataye, da sauransu) a cikin littattafan rubutunsu. Za a koya ma'anonin waɗannan sassan a tsawon atisayen da za a gudanar. Wace fasaha ta ji ta gaba ya kamata ɗalibai su mallaka don samun nasarar ɗaukar sabon ilimin?
answer_a: Banbance-banbancen kaɗe-kaɗen waƙoƙi marasa rikitarwa
answer_b: Gano ci gaban sautin jituwa
answer_c: Gano maimaituwa da bambance-bambancen kaulin waƙa
answer_d: Gane siffofin mabanbanta biyu

question: Aji na uku na makarantar sakandare, wata malama tana shirin wani darasi kan tasirin Afirka a cikin kiɗan Amurka. A matsayin wani ɓangare na abin da za ta koyar, ta sanya wannan manufar koyo: "Yi nazari kan misalan kiɗa a kasashen Amurka inda tasirin kiɗan Afirka ke bayyana." Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan da ɗaliban za su yi ta dace da manufar koyon da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Kwatanta nau'o'in waƙoƙin Afirka da na Mapuche daban-daban
answer_b: Bincika ganguna a al'adun kafin zuwan Columbus
answer_c: Siffanta kaɗe-kaɗen da rera waƙa a cikin kumbia ta ƙasar Kolombiya
answer_d: rubuta bambance-bambancen bugun kidan da suka shahara a Afirka

question: A cikin wani aikin kiɗa, malami na so ya gabatar da batun "Chords Masu Maye Gurbin Manyan Ayyukan Ma'aunin Major Scale". Wane ilimin da aka riga aka samu ne wajibi don fara gabatar da wannan abun ciki?
answer_a: Da'irar biyar-biyar
answer_b: Sa hannuwar ma'ajin maƙarƙaṣin babba
answer_c: Sautin da ke a tsakani tsakanin kari
answer_d: Juyawar Sautuna zuwa Karamin Dangi

question: Malamin yana gudanar da aikin rukuni. Malamin yana so ya yi amfani da kayan kimantawa guda biyu. Za a yi amfani da kayan auna na farko yayin aikin don rubuta matakin ci gaba na kammala aikin kowace rukuni, kuma za a yi amfani da kayan auna na biyu a ƙarshen aikin don haɓaka ƙwarewar ɗalibai na tunani a kan ci gaban aikin. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ne ya fi gabatarwa, bi da bi, kayan kimantawa da suka fi dacewa da manufofin malamin?
answer_a: Jerin abubuwan dubawa da ginshikin maki na kowane mutum
answer_b: Rubutun labari da ƙa'idojin rukuni
answer_c: Jagorar tantancewar takwarori da rikodin labari
answer_d: Ma'aunin yabo da jagorar kimanta kai

question:
A cikin aji na Shekara ta Biyu, wani malam yana lura da yadda ake gudanar da wata waka da kayan kida tare. Da isarsu sashin maimaitawa (kari), sai ya lura cewa ɗaliban da ke buga gitar lantarki sun kasa sarrafa karfin sautinsu, wanda hakan ya hana jin babban sautin wakar da biyolin ke yi. Malamin ya yanke shawarar ba ɗaliban martani mai gyarawa game da amfani da karfin sauti.
Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ne ya fi dacewa da samar da martani mai gyarawa?
answer_a: Malamin ya nemi dalibai su gabatar da ƙarfin sauti daban-daban da ke cikin waƙar ba tare da not ɗin fedal ba don su shigar da su ciki kuma su fahimce su.
answer_b: Malamin ya gaya wa ɗalibai cewa yana da muhimmanci a ji biola sama da sauran kayan kida, kuma ya ce su duba ƙarar sautin su.
answer_c: Malamin ya tunatar da ɗaliban ra'ayin dynamiks kuma ya ce su binciki bambance-bambancen ƙarfi da za su iya cimmawa a kan kayan kaɗe-kaɗensu
answer_d: Malami ya nemi ɗalibai su gano kayan kaɗe da ke ɗauke da babban zubin waƙa, kuma ya gayyace su su daidaita ƙarfi bisa ga wannan zubin waƙar

question: A cikin makarantar sakandire ta shekara ta uku, malama tana tsarawa darasi kan wakar zamani. Daya daga cikin manufofin koyarwarta shi ne kamar haka: "Don fahimtar halayen ginawa da salo na tsarin waka, a dunkule kuma a kunne." Wanne daga cikin zabuka masu zuwa ne ya gabatar da ma'aunin tantancewa da ya dace da manufar koyarwa da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Kiramelo mai gaba da biyo baya (antecedent and consequent)
answer_b: Gano sassa/ɓangarorin/rukunan waƙar pop
answer_c: Tana nazarin tsarin rondo mai jigo biyu
answer_d: Gane muhimman fasalolin wakar kida

question: A cikin aji na shekara ta biyu ta makarantar sakandare, wata malama za ta fara aiki a kan ɓangaren sassaka mai mai da hankali kan muhimman halayen ƙungiyoyin fasaha na 'avant-garde' na ƙarni na 20. Don yin wannan, ɓangaren zai fara ne da aikin nazari na abubuwan da cubism ya gabatar. Wane ilimin da suka koya a baya ya kamata ɗalibai su samu don magance wannan aikin?
answer_a: Fahimtar hangen nesa, irin na fasahar Renaissance
answer_b: Hoton alamace-alamace, wanda ya zama siffar masu fasahar ƙungiyar Blue Rider
answer_c: Wakilcin tsarin siffa na zane, wanda ya dace da yaren gumakan (icons) na Byzantine
answer_d: Barin hanyar nuna siffofi ta makaranta, wadda ta bambanta masu zane na Vienna Secession

question: A ajin shekara ta biyu na makarantar sakandare, a cikin sashin "Zane-zanen Hoto," ɗalibai za su fara wani aiki wanda burinsa shine su tsara wata talla mai jan hankali (poster) don sanar da al'ummar makarantar game da nunin zane-zane mai zuwa. Idan aka yi la'akari da abin da ke sama, waɗanne ra'ayoyi ne ya kamata ɗalibai su fahimta don ƙirƙirar tallar (poster) da aka nema?
answer_a: Zane-zane, taken-take, alamta-tambari
answer_b: Tsari, rubutu, hoto
answer_c: Hoto, rubutu, abun ciki
answer_d: Kwatance, tsarin rubutu, zane-zane

question: A cikin sashin koyar da hoto a aji na biyu na makarantar sakandire, wata malama ta gabatar wa ɗalibai ruwan tabarau daban-daban da ake amfani da su a hotunan analog don ƙirƙirar hotuna, tana mai ba da hankali kan ruwan tabarau mai kama da idon kifi (fisheye). Don bayyana shi, ta karanta musu ma'anar kamar haka: “Ruwan tabarau na fisheye yana da kusurwar kallo na digiri 180 ko fiye, wanda ke ba da damar samun karkatattun hotuna.” Bayan karantawar, za ta nuna musu misalai na tasirin idon kifi. Wane misali ne daga rayuwar yau da kullum malamar za ta iya ba ɗaliban don sauƙaƙe fahimtar wannan tasiri?
answer_a: Hoton da aka nuna a madubi mai rami
answer_b: Hoton da aka gani ta cikin gilashi mai kasan kauri
answer_c: Hoto da aka gani a cikin hasken ruwan da ke cikin kwantena
answer_d: Hoton da aka gani a cikin hasken cokali

question:
A shekara ta uku ta sakandire, wata malama ta fara aiki tare da ɗalibanta a kan aikin zane ta hanyar *Expressionism*.
Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa malamar za ta iya amfani da shi don kusantar aikin ta hanyar da aka nuna?
answer_a: Ku tambayi ɗalibai game da ra'ayoyi ko jigogi da suke so su zana a kansu, bisa ga abubuwan da suke so da kuma motsin zuciyar su, don yin aiki a kan ayyukansu
answer_b: Ku gabatar da wani zane-zane a matsayin farkon farawa don bunkasa aikin, don ɗalibai su warware kuma su yi amfani da shi a cikin ayyukan zane-zanen su
answer_c: Ku gina tattaunawa da ɗalibai game da fasahohin zane da za su iya amfani da su a ayyukansu, don haɓaka shiga, nazari mai zurfi, da kuma sadar da abubuwan da ke damunsu
answer_d: Bada shawara ga ɗalibai su gudanar da bincike a kan wani mai zane na zaɓin su, tare da gano halaye na zane-zane a cikin aikin su, don daga baya su yi amfani da su a cikin ayyukan zane-zanen su

question: A cikin ajin makarantar sakandare na shekara ta huɗu, a cikin sashin "Binciken Harsunan Inji da Lantarki: Fasahar Bidiyo", wani malami zai yi aiki da ɗalibai a kan manufar ajin kamar haka: don gano halayen ginshiƙi na wannan hanyar bayyanawa. Waɗanne ne daga cikin waɗannan kayan koyarwa za su bai wa malamin damar cimma manufar ajin?
answer_a: Nuna faifan bidiyo mai sauti na aikin gina Spiral Jetty, na Robert Smithson
answer_b: Biyo bidiyoyin allo na wasannin Marina Abramovic sannan ku bincika su tare da ɗalibai
answer_c: Ku gabatar da wani aiki mai ji da gani na Juan Downey sannan ku bincika shi tare da ɗalibai
answer_d: Ku gabatar da wani shirin gaskiya game da rayuwa da aikin Bill Viola

question: Dangane da darasin nan mai taken “Matasa da Batutuwan Sannu-a-hankali na Kafofin Watsa Labarai na Zamani”, wanda aka gudanar a ajin ɗalibai na shekara ta biyu, wani malami ya yi shiri cewa aji zai koyi dabarar stenciling (zane ta amfani da fenti da kwaikwayo) sannan su yi amfani da ita a aikin gani wanda ya dogara da tunaninsu na kansu. Don yin wannan, malamin ya yanke shawarar yin amfani da wani kayan aikin koyarwa wanda zai ba da damar gabatar da dabarar da aka tattauna ga ɗaliban. Wanne ne a cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya ba da shawarar kayan aikin koyarwa wanda zai magance wannan manufa da aka faɗa?
answer_a: Shugaban fasahar hoto ta asali wadda aka yi da tambari
answer_b: Bidiyo game da dabarun da Keith Haring ya yi amfani da su a cikin ayyukansa
answer_c: Takardar shaida game da aiki da dabarun da mai zanen gani TAKI 183 ya yi amfani da su
answer_d: Darasi kan tsoma baki a titi ta masu fasaha masu amfani da salon Wild Style

question:
Bayan sun yi godiya ga kyawun wasu kayan zane daga ƙungiyar fasahar zane mai siffofi, sun sake duba tarihin mahallinsu, kuma sun gudanar da binciken gani, wani malami ya ba ɗalibansa umarni kamar haka:

"Ku ƙirƙiri zane-zane na farko da yawa, a matsayin wani ra'ayi, inda za ku tsara wani tsarin zane mai cirewa (abstract composition), bisa ga zaɓin wani abu mai mahimmanci, tare da danganta tsarin ku da ɗayan mawallafa da aka duba."

Wane mataki na tsarin sassauci na aikin ƙirƙira umarnin malamin ya dace da shi?
answer_a: Ka fito da wata gasa mai buƙatar ƙirƙira
answer_b: Yi tunani kuma a tantance tsarin yadda aka yi abin
answer_c: Shirya wani aiki
answer_d: Ku gabatar da shawarar farko

question: A cikin ajin Shekara ta Farko (na sakandire), don bunkasa abubuwan da suka shafi daukar hoto, wata malama ta gabatar da hotuna waɗanda ke nuna misalai na kusurwoyin daukar hoto daban-daban da kuma fage. Bayan sun kalli kuma sun yi nazarin hotunan, sai ta nemi daliban su yi aiki a kan abin da aka koya ta hanyar daukar hotuna a wurare daban-daban a cikin makarantar. Za a tantance wannan aikin a matakin ginawa ta amfani da ma'aunin tantancewa. La'akari da aikin da aka bayar, wanne ne daga cikin wadannan abubuwa masu nuni ya dace a sanya a cikin kayan aikin?
answer_a: Suna amfani da kusurwoyi da tsare-tsare daban-daban dangane da manufofinsu na bayyanawa
answer_b: Suna gano kusurwoyi da firam-firam a tsarin gine-ginen makarantar
answer_c: Suna amfani da kusurwoyi da tsare-tsare daban-daban a cikin hotunansu
answer_d: Suna gano nau'ukan kusurwoyi da firam-firam da za su yi amfani da su wajen tsara hotunansu

question:
A cikin aji na shekara ta 4 na sakandare, wani malami yana aiki a kan salon zanen hotuna na Edvard Munch. Don magance wannan abun ciki, ya gayyaci ɗalibansa su ƙirƙiri zanen adadi bisa ga wannan tunani, wanda za a tantance shi da jerin abubuwan dubawa.

Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya ƙunshi alamar da ta dace a haɗa a cikin kayan aiki?
answer_a:
Amfani da kayan shafa don samar da hotuna masu kama da na gaske
Amfani da kayan shafa don samar da hotuna masu kama da na gaske
answer_b: Yana amfani da launuka masu ƙarfi da tsabta don gurɓata siffofi
answer_c: Amfani da bambance-bambancen haske da inuwa don ƙirƙirar girma
answer_d: Amfani da siffa da wuri don samar da zurfin yanayi (atmospheric depth)

question: A matakin makarantar yara ƙanana, malama za ta yi aiki a kan manufar koyo: “Nuna sha’awa ga kama, tana mai mayar da martani ta hanyoyi daban-daban, kamar su guggi, alamomi, murmushi, da sauransu,” daga babban rukuni na Harsunan Fasaha. Don yin haka, ta ajiye tubala daban-daban da aka rufe da kala-kalan kama a cikin ɗakin domin yaran su bincika. Bayan wani ɗan lokaci, wani yaro ya binciki kayan kuma ya fara mayar da martani. Malamar ta matso kusa kuma ta sauka zuwa matakin yaron. Dangane da halin da aka bayyana, wane irin sa hannu daga malamar ne zai iya sauƙaƙa cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Tambaya: “Wace kala ce take jikin wannan bulo da kake taɓawa? Wancan mai laushi ne, wannan kuma mai kaushi ne. Wanne kake so ka ɗauka?”
answer_b: Tambaya: Kayan da na bari sun yi maka daɗi? Kana so ka taɓa wani daban? Za ka iya kaiwa gare shi? Zan kawo shi kusa da kai.
answer_c: Kuna taba tubalan masu labuloli, murmushinku yana gaya mini kun fi son labuli mai santsi. Wannan yana da datsi, kuna so ku taba shi?
answer_d: Kana taba tubalan masu zane-zane, suna burge ka? Kana so ka taba wani kuma? Dauke shi da hannunka. Ka yi gugugi, mai kyau sosai!

question: Mai koyar da yara ƙanana zai yi aiki kan manufar koyo: “Fassarar waƙoƙi, ta hanyar haɗa albarkatu daban-daban kamar murya, jiki, kayan kiɗa, da abubuwa,” daga ainihin Harsunan Fasaha. Wace irin rawar da yaran za su yi ce za ta nuna cimma wannan manufar koyo?
answer_a: Yi motsin jiki bisa ga gudun kiɗan
answer_b: Yi rawa kana motsa jiki da alamomi gwargwadon ƙarfin kiɗan
answer_c: A nuna bugun tare ta amfani da kayan kaɗe-kaɗe daban-daban
answer_d: Waka daban-daban tare da nuna kidan da tafi da motsin kai

question: Malamar makarantar yara tana da niyyar cimma manufar koyarwa mai zuwa tare da yara ƙanana: “Su isar da ra’ayoyinsu da yadda suke ji game da ayyukan fasaha daban-daban.” Don yin haka, ta gayyace su su ga wani nune-nunen fasaha wanda ke nuna kwafen manyan ayyuka na masu fasaha daga ko'ina cikin duniya. Yayin da suke yawon shakatawa a nune-nunen, suna lura da kowane ɗayan shahararrun zane-zanen a hankali. Pedro ya lura da zanen mai suna The Scream a hankali. Malamar ta matso kusa da shi ta tambaye shi: “Me kake gani a cikin wannan zanen?” Yaron ya amsa: “Wani mutum ne da yake ihu.” Wane daga cikin maganganun da ke gaba malamar za ta iya yi wa Pedro don ba shi martani a kan amsar sa da kuma inganta cimma manufar koyarwa da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Da kyau ƙwarai! Wannan aikin ana kiransa “Ƙarar” kuma shi ne mafi muhimmanci a wurin wannan mai zanen. Me ya sa kake ganin ya zana mutum yana ihu? Wanene zai iya zama wannan mutumin?
answer_b: Kuna son wannan aiki? Me ya ja hankalinka? Me ya sa mutumin yake kururuwa? Wannan hoton an kira shi “The Scream” kuma lallai ya nuna wani mutum yana kururuwa
answer_c: Wannan zanen ana kiransa “Ihun” kuma na wajen mai zane ɗan Norway ne, Edvard Munch. Waɗanne layuka kuke gani a cikin zanen? Waɗanne launuka suka fi yawa? Waɗanne wasu abubuwa kuke gani a cikin zanen?
answer_d:
Me ya sa kake tunanin mutumin yana ihu?
Me kake zaton yana faruwa da shi?
Wane irin ji kake yi idan ka ga wannan aikin?
Ana kiran wannan zane “Ihu” (The Scream) kuma na mai zane ɗan ƙasar Norway ne mai suna Edvard Munch

question: Malamar makarantar gaba da firamare da ke aiki da yara masu ɗan girma za ta gabatar da abubuwan koyo daban-daban lokacin taron rukuni don bunƙasa manufar koyo mai zuwa daga fannin Harsunan Fasaha: “Kwaikwayon motsin hannu, motsi, da sautuka daga muhallinsu mai ma'ana, ta hanyoyi daban-daban.” Wacece daga cikin abubuwan koyo masu zuwa ce ke bada damar cimma manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Ku gabatar da tatsuniya ga yara kuma ku gayyace su su ƙirƙiri abin rufe fuska na halin da suka fi so
answer_b: Ku gabatar da waƙoƙin sauti dabam-dabam na dabbobi ga yara kuma ku tambaye su su gano su ta hanyar ambaton sunayensu
answer_c: Ku gayyaci yara su yi wasan Simon Ya ce (ko wani sunan wasan da kuka saba) kuma ku nuna, ta hanyar kwaikwayo da hannu da jiki (mime), abubuwa daban-daban da dole ne su gano kuma su kawo.
answer_d: Gayyaci yara su rera kuma su rawa waƙoƙi masu buƙatar motsa jiki, kamar su “Ga Sautin Kada” da “Dodo na Tafkin.”

question: Malamar kula da yara ƙanana ta tsara manufar koyo mai zuwa daga muhimmin jigon Harsunan Fasaha: "Don wakilci abubuwan al'ajabi, ra'ayoyi, abubuwan da aka fuskanta, da sha'awa ta hanyar zane, ta hanyar layi, siffofi, kala, da laushi, da goyon baya da kayan aiki a matakin fili da na girma." Don cimma wannan, za su aiwatar da aikin da ake kira "Ƙirƙirar dabba" tare da rukunin yaran nasu, tare da tattara bayanai kan yadda yaran suka gudanar da aikin ta hanyar hotuna. Wace dabara ce daga cikin waɗannan da ke gaba za ta baiwa malamin damar tattara shaidu game da cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Bawa yara zabbabbun ayyukan fasaha daban-daban da ke da alaƙa da dabbobi, sa'annan ka tambaye su su faɗi yadda waɗannan ayyuka ke sa su ji a zuciya. Bayan haka, ka ce su zaɓi ɗaya don su wakilta.
answer_b: Ku ba wa yara zaɓuɓɓukan dabbobin gida guda uku don su zaɓi ɗaya kuma su wakilta shi da kayan da za a iya sake sarrafa su. Sa'an nan, ku ce su gabatar wa iyalansu dabarun da suka yi amfani da su wajen ƙirƙirar ta
answer_c: Ku bai wa yara kayayyaki iri-iri kuma ku ce su zaɓi wasu don su ƙirƙiri wakilcin dabbar gida. Sai kuma ku gayyace su su gabatar wa abokan ajinsu dalilin da ya sa wannan dabbar ta musamman ce
answer_d: Bawa yara bidiyo da ke bayyana matakan da za su bi don ƙirƙirar wakilcin dabba. Sa'an nan, gayyace su su shirya baje kolin fasaha inda za su nuna abubuwan da suka ƙirƙira ga al'umma

question: Wata malamar makarantar yara ƙanana tana aiki akan aikin nan mai suna "Jin da ke rayuwa a cikina". Wannan aikin ya haɗa da manufar koyo daga ainihin Darussan Harsunan Fasaha: "Don bayyana ji, ra'ayoyi, da abubuwan da aka fuskanta ta hanyar fasaha ta hanyar gwaji da kayayyakin hoto, zane-zane, da na yin samfuri". A tsawon aikin, sun gudanar da abubuwa daban-daban, kuma a kammala, malamar ta gayyaci yaran su gabatar da abubuwan da suka ƙirƙira a lokacin wannan aikin. Yayin da Martina take gabatar da aikinta, ta ce: "Na yi ƙwallaye biyu, ɗaya rawaya ɗaya kore, saboda su ne launukan da na fi so". Malamar ta tambaya: "Wane ji zanenki yake bayyanawa?". Martina ta amsa: "Ban sani ba". Wane shisshigin malama daga cikin masu zuwa ya dace don taimaka wa Martina ta cimma manufar koyo?
answer_a: Madallah, Martina! Na ga aikinki ya nuna wasan ƙwallaye masu kala. Kin ji daɗin yin wasa da ƙwallaye? Me ya sa ƙwallo ɗaya kore ce, ɗayar kuma rawaya ce? Shin suna tunatar da ke wani irin ji?
answer_b: Aikin da kika yi, Martina, yana da kyau sosai! Ƙwallayen da kika ƙirƙira suna cikin launukan da muke amfani da su don gane motsin rai. Kore yana wakiltar natsuwa, kuma rawaya yana wakiltar farin ciki
answer_c: Madalla, Martina! Kin zaɓi launukan da kinfi so don aikinki. Zaki iya gaya mani dalilin da ya sa kika zana ƙwallaye? Me kike ji yayin da kika ga launin kore da rawaya? Me ya sa sune kika fi so?
answer_d: Aiki mai kyau, Martina! Amma za ki so ki kammala aikinki, kina tuna cewa kina buƙatar nuna wata gogewa da kuma wani jin rai? Yana iya zama farin cikin buga ƙwallo da abokanki ko kuma baƙin ciki idan kika rasa ƙwallon

question: A cikin aji na biyar, malama za ta mai da hankali kan manufa mai zuwa: “Don yin ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire ba zato ba tsammani da ƙirƙirar ra'ayoyin kiɗa tare da wata manufa da kuma isasshen sanin harshen kiɗa.” Don cimma wannan, za ta nemi ɗalibai su yi rakiyar kiɗa da ba zato ba tsammani ta hanyar amfani da kayan kaɗe-kaɗe daban-daban don rakiyar wakar. Wace aiki ce ta dace don bunkasa wannan manufa?
answer_a: Malami yana rubuta tsarin kari daban-daban a kan allo domin ɗalibai su kwaikwaya daga baya, sannan su bambanta su a cikin fasahar kirkiro nasu bisa sautin da dole ne su raka
answer_b: Malamar tana kunna sauti na kayan kaɗe-kaɗen Afirka a cikin aji. Sai ta nemi ɗaliban su yi amfani da waɗannan asali ra'ayoyi a matsayin tushe don su yi nasu zunguretun (improvisations) kuma su gabatar da su a kan sautin waƙar da aka gabatar.
answer_c: Malamar ta ce dalibai su saurari wata waƙa, sannan ta yi misalan wasu nau'ikan kaƙa-gida da abubuwa masu sauti daban-daban. Daga nan kuma ta ce su kwaikwaye su ta hanyar bugu (ko: ta hanyar amo)
answer_d: Malamar ta umarci ɗalibai su saurari waƙar, sannan su kaɗa kaɗa-kaɗen tushe daban-daban. Sa'an nan, ta shirya wani rondo na kiɗa tare da ɗaliban, suna musanya kirkirar kaɗa-kaɗen su na nan take.

question: Wace sanayya ta farko ce dole sai ɗalibai sun mallaka kafin su fara nazarin Ilimin Waƙa?
answer_a: Tsakanin Lokaci
answer_b: Bakin sautin kiɗa
answer_c: Ayyuka na asali
answer_d: Sikelin manya da ƙanana

question: A aji na bakwai, a taron koyon rukunin kayan kiɗa, malamin ya kasance yana aiki kan fassarar wani tsarin kiɗa na muryoyi biyu da rafiyar kayan kiɗa. Ɗaliban, a rukunin-rukunin, sun gabatar da fassarar su ta kiɗan, suna la’akari da ka’idojin daidaiton rithm, daidaiton sautin jituwa da na waƙa, da kuma ingantaccen amfani da albarkatun bayyana motsin rai da fasahar kayan kiɗa. A ƙarshen gabatarwar, malamin ya gano cewa wani rukunin ɗalibai sun yi kurakuran dogo a wasu alamomin kiɗa, suna kashewa da tsarin *gallops* a maimakon *syncopations* a lokacin da waɗannan suka bayyana a rubutun kiɗan. Wane mabudin gyara na koyarwa daga malamin zai baiwa ɗaliban damar shawo kan kuskuren tare da cika ka’idojin da aka tsayar na fassarar kiɗan?
answer_a: Babu shakka sun inganta yadda suka gudanar da wannan kida sosai; sai dai, akwai sauran damar gyara karatun kida. Wane bangare na fassarar kida kake ganin ya fi rauni?
answer_b: Ina taya ka murna da yadda ka buga ko ka rera waƙar yadda ya kamata. Na gaba, ina gayyatarka da ka saurari sauti (audio) na waƙar, kana mai mai da hankali kan tsarin bugun (metric) da kuma gudun (tempo) waƙar, waɗanda su ne har yanzu suke buƙatar gyara ko haɓakawa
answer_c: A yayin fassarar, ka kai matuƙar babban iyawa na mai da hankali, taya murna! Dangane da al'amuran bugu, wajibi ne a gyara yadda ake aiwatar da *gallops* lokacin da ake gabatar da su tare
answer_d: Rawani na sautuka da daidaiton waƙa sun kai matakin fassara mai inganci. Game da ɓangaren kidaya, za ka iya banbance tsakanin wace raba-rabar bugu ce take bayyana a rubutun waƙa da kuma wadda ka yi a cikin fassararka?

question: Malami tana aiki da ajin aji na 8 a kan sashin Sauraro, Rera Waƙa, da Kiɗa. Sannan, za ta tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa: “Fassara waƙoƙi masu alaƙa da kiɗan da aka saurara; galibi la’akari da ci gaban fasahar kwarewar tsarin furuci da kuzari”. Wane alamomi ne ke nuna cimma wannan koyo?
answer_a: Suna rera waka da wasa, suna mai da hankali kan farko da ƙarshen salo, suna fassara shi da ma'anar kiɗa
answer_b: Suna waƙa da kiɗa a cikin muryoyi fiye da ɗaya, suna la'akari da fannonin kari na musamman ga aikin da salon
answer_c: Suna rerawa da kaɗa waƙoƙi bisa ga tsarin sautuka irin na fasalin salon aikin da suke fassara.
answer_d: Suna rera waƙa kuma suna kaɗa suna amfani da na'urorin daidaita numfashi da tsanani a cikin aikin da aka fassara.

question: Malamin aji na shida zai tantance ɗalibansa dangane da manufar koyo mai zuwa: “Gano halayen kiɗa na musamman na jerin raye-rayen gargajiya na ƙasar Chile da daidai alaƙarsu da yankin ƙasa da suka fito.” Wane aiki ne zai ba da shaidar nasarar koyo ga ɗaliban?
answer_a: Suna gabatar da rawan gargajiya iri-iri daga sassa daban-daban na kasar, suna amfani da kayan kida da muryoyinsu
answer_b: Suna nuni ga kiɗan gargajiya da na zamani na raye-rayen gargajiya na ƙasar Chile da suka sani kuma suna rarraba shi bisa ga rinjayen waƙarsa.
answer_c: Suna ƙirƙirar taswirar Chile wadda suka sanya kayan kida na asali da raye-rayen gargajiya a yankunansu na ƙasa da suka dace
answer_d: Sun saurari na'urori daban-daban na kiɗan raye-raye na gargajiya na ƙasar Chile kuma sun rarraba su ta yankin yanki, bisa ga kayan kaɗe-kaɗensu da rinjayayyen kaɗe-kaɗensu

question: A lokacin wani aji na 7, a cikin sashen ɗaukar hoto, wata malama tana aiki tare da ɗalibanta kan ƙa’idojin yaren ɗaukar hoto. Bayan ta yi bayani da baki ko ta hanyar zane game da ra’ayoyin firam, kusurwoyi, da maida hankali, sai ta nemi ɗaliban su ɗauki hotuna a filin makaranta, suna amfani da kusurwoyi daban-daban da aka tattauna. Yayin da take lura da aikin, malamar ta lura cewa a cikin yawancin hotunan, ɗaliban sun yi amfani da firam daban-daban ne kawai ba tare da sun yi amfani da kusurwoyi ba, hakan ya nuna cewa suna ruɗa firam da kusurwar ɗaukar hoto. Wace daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa malamar za ta iya neman ɗaliban su yi don fayyace ra’ayin kusurwoyi a zahiri?
answer_a: Ɗauki hotunan abokin ajinka da ke can ƙarshen ɗakin, a tazara daban-daban, har sai ka rage mita ɗaya da shi
answer_b: Dubi a cikin mujalla hotuna da ke nuna firam da kusurwa daban-daban, sannan ka wakilta su ta hanyar ɗaukar hoto na wani abu daga cikin ajin da ka zaɓa.
answer_c: Ɗauki hotunan akwatin fensir a kan teburin gilashi, inda za ka sanya kyamara a sama da akwatin yayin da kake tsaye a kan kujera, sannan kuma a ƙasansa yayin da kake kwance a ƙasa
answer_d: Ɗauki hotunan jakar baya a kan tebur da ke tsakiyar ɗakin, daga sassa daban-daban na da'irar da aka zana a ƙasa kewaye da shi

question: A cikin ajin shida, a cikin darasin Sassaƙa da sauran hanyoyin bugu, ɗalibai za su ƙirƙiri zane na hoto mai siffa a kan takarda don amfani da raga na bugun allo. Wace dabara ce ɗaliban ke buƙatar ƙwarewa a kai tun farko don su iya gudanar da aikin?
answer_a: Sassaƙa-katako
answer_b: Sitensil
answer_c: Monotype
answer_d: Hotomantaj

question: Malamar aji na 7, a cikin kashin Ƙirƙirar Ganin Gani, mutum da yanayi, tana aiki da ɗalibanta kan muhimman siffofin fasahar ƙasa, bisa ga lura da binciken ayyukan masu fasaha waɗanda suka wakilce shi. Sannan, ta gabatar da shawara cewa su yi amfani da abin da suka koya a wani aikin shiga tsakani a wani wurin shakatawa kusa da makarantar kuma su ɗauki hotunan shaida na ayyukan fasahar. Malamar za ta tantance sakamakon da aka samu ta hanyar ma'aunin kimantawa. Don tattara shaida game da nasarar koyon ɗalibanta, wace alamar tantancewa malamar za ta iya la'akari da haɗawa a cikin kayan aikin tantancewar?
answer_a: Suna ƙirƙirar rubutaccen hoto da ke bayyana tsarin yin aikin zane da kuma sakamakon ƙarshe na shi
answer_b: Suna zaɓar kayan halitta ko na gargajiya don aikin nasu, daidai da ayyukan fasahar ƙasar (land art)
answer_c: Suna kafa dangantaka tsakanin shimfiɗar wuri inda suke shigar da aikinsu da kuma manufar bayyanawa da suke so su isar.
answer_d: Suna tantance abubuwan gani a cikin misalan ayyukan fasahar ƙasa, don ƙirƙirar zane-zanensu kafin a fara samar da aikin

question: Malamin ajin farko na makarantar sakandare yana aiki a kan wani yanki na waka mai murya, musamman wani canon mai sauti ɗaya na muryoyi uku. Bayan ya bayyana wannan tsari na kiɗa, ya lura cewa ɗalibansa ba su fahimce shi sosai ba, don haka ya ba da shawarar yin amfani da kwatanci don sauƙaƙa musu fahimta. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya gabatar da kwatanci mai dacewa don taimaka wa ɗalibai su fahimci yadda ake aiwatar da canon mai sauti ɗaya?
answer_a: Ka yi tunani ana gudanar da gasar tseren miƙa sanda, kuma an miƙa sandar ga abokin wasa a daidai lokacin nan, sannan sai a miƙa ta ga na gaba a lokutan da aka tsara. Haka nan yake faruwa da waƙar da za a rera.
answer_b: Ka ɗauka mutane uku suna karanta waƙoƙi daban-daban a lokaci guda, kuma a saurin kari ɗaya, suna dacewa kuma suna cika ma juna, wanda hakan ke samar da sabon ma'ana ga rubutun. Idan a fannin kiɗa ne, ya kamata a maye gurbin rubutun da waƙoƙin rero.
answer_c: Ka yi tunanin na'urorin kunna sauti da yawa masu waƙa ɗaya sannan ka danna kunnawa a kan kowace ɗayansu da wani jinkiri na adadin bugu. A yanayin waƙoƙin da aka rera, kowace ɗayan waɗannan na'urori za ta zama rukunin mawaƙa
answer_d: Ka ɗauka an yi zane farawa da layi mai launi ɗaya daga farkon shafin, sannan kuma, a wani tazara, an zana wani layi mai launi dabam, da sauransu. Layukan masu launi za su zama waƙoƙin da za a rera, kuma santimita na tazarar za su zama lokutan jira

question: A wani aji na uku na makarantar sakandare, ɗalibai suna aikin ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire, saboda malamin darasi ya umurce su su ƙirƙiri wani ɗan ƙaramin tsari na sauti (composition) kowa da kansa. Wani ɗalibi bai gane umarnin nan take ba sai ya nemi malamin ya yi masa bayani da sauƙaƙan kalmomi game da abin da tsari na sauti ya ƙunsa. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ne ya gabatar da amsar malami wadda take da inganci a fasahance amma kuma an yi ta da harshen da ɗalibin zai iya fahimta?
answer_a: Shi ne don ƙirƙirar jere-jere na sauti waɗanda ke amsa umarnin da aka bayar ta hanyar maƙami na asali ko maƙami na farko.
answer_b: Nisanta da komawa ga babban sauti ne akai-akai, cikin yanayi mai daɗin sauti.
answer_c: Don tsara wani aiki ne cikin tsarin kiɗa da aka ayyana, bisa ga dabara ta matakai a kewayen sauti na asali, tare da mafi yawan amfani da jituwar sauti mai daɗi a cikinsa
answer_d: Don haɓaka wani tsari na kiɗa ta hanyar hanyoyin tsarawa da albarkatu daban-daban

question: Malamin aji na uku na sakandire yana shirya wata waƙar murya tare da ajinsa. A wani sashe na musamman na waƙar, ɗaliban dole su yi amfani da yanayin ƙarfin murya na *piano* (a rera a hankali); duk da haka, idan suna waƙa, suna yawan yin *rallentando* (jinkirin gudun waƙar) wanda ba a nuna shi ba a wajen. Wace shawara ko taimako malamin zai yi don sauƙaƙa wa ɗaliban su fassara waƙar tare da kiyaye *tempo*?
answer_a: Bari ɗalibai su yi aikin da ƙarfi mara canzawa, domin su iya gane sakamakon da ƙarfin aiki mai kyau.
answer_b: Yi amfani da wani faifan murya na aikin da ƙwararrun ƙungiyar mawaƙa ta yi, domin ɗalibai su saurari sakamakon ƙarshe kuma su gane inda ya kamata a rage ƙarfin murya
answer_c: Bayyana ma'aunin kuzari (dynamics) da na kuzari na ciki (agogics) daban-daban, tare da amfani da haɗe-haɗe daban-daban ga aikin, don ɗalibai su iya gane kowane ma'auni.
answer_d: Ku nemi ɗalibai su yi motsa jiki na murya don gano yiwuwar canje-canje na ƙarar muryarsu, don haɓaka ikonsu kan sigar ƙarfin sauti a cikin wasan kwaikwayonsu

question: Wani malamin aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare yana magance karanta wani rubutaccen kiɗa (score) na ƙungiyar kaɗe-kaɗe, wanda galibi ya ƙunshi rukuni-rukuni na sifofin kari waɗanda aka samo daga tsarin kiɗan ɗan gajeren lokaci na goma sha shida (quartet of sixteenth notes). Dalibai suna nuna wahala wajen karantawa da kuma aiwatar da karin *gallops* da juyewar da ke da wuya a fahimta, da kuma *syncopations* da *triplets*. Wacece daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ce za ta ba da damar magance matsalar karatu ta kari tare da ɗalibai da kuma inganta yiwuwar canja wurin koyo zuwa wasu yanayi?
answer_a: Ku umarci ɗalibai su ƙidaya rabon kashi goma sha shida da babbar murya a bugu mai tafiya a hankali, suna buga salon waƙar har sai sun iya gane tsawon lokacin kowane salo da kansu.
answer_b: Yi wasannin silabi da kalmomi waɗanda suka dace da rukunai masu sarkakiya, ta yadda ɗalibai za su danganta kuma su haddace ta hanyar ji, sannan su samu ƙarin daidaito a wajen aiwatar da waɗancan siffofin kiɗa
answer_c: Gudanar da ma'auni da rabe-rabensa ta hanyar ruri, yayin da ɗalibai ke buga tsarin kari masu sarkakiya da kayan kidansu, har sai sun sami damar haɗa su
answer_d: Kirkiri wani atisayen raba hankali na kida mai haɗakar salo, domin ɗalibai su riƙe bugun kari da hannu ɗaya, kuma su buga yanayin kari mai sarkakiya da ɗayan hannun, har sai sun iya daidaita su.

question: Malami na shekara ta biyu ta sakandire yana niyyar tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa: “Fassara saloli daban-daban na waƙoƙi ga murya ɗaya ko fiye, tare da sanin salon waƙa, ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyin yin rikodi da watsawa wajen sarrafawa da yaɗa aikin waƙarsu.” Wane matakin aiki na ɗalibi ne ke nuna cikar wannan manufa da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Suna amfani da nannannun makin kiɗa da waɗanda ba na kiɗa ba, rakodin, gabatarwa ta hanyar dijital, da sauransu, a cikin gabatarwarsu ta kiɗa, gwargwadon bukatunsu da sha'awarsu
answer_b: Suna kwaikwayo da sauti daga kayayyaki daban-daban, yanayi, ko ra'ayoyi, suna nuna ƙwarewa da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire a amfani da kayan aiki
answer_c: Suna bayar da kyawawan kimantawa na nasu da na abokanansu game da wasan kwaikwayo na kiɗa, suna la'akari da fannoni kamar su gudana, asali, jajircewa, da sauransu
answer_d: Suna bayyana hanyoyi dabam-dabam na yin rikodi da watsa kida, gwargwadon irin abin da ake gabatarwa da kuma lokacin tarihi da yake faruwa a ciki

question: Wata malamar ajin makarantar sakandire na shekara ta uku ta sanya wa ɗalibai manufar fassara kiɗa tare da sanin salo, daidaiton fasaha, da kuma kwarjini. Don cimma wannan buri, ta zaɓi wani aiki na rera waƙa mai murya huɗu wanda dukkanin ɗaliban ajin za su yi. A yayin aikin, ta lura cewa ko da yake suna rera waƙar da kwarjini kuma suna da masaniyar salon aikin lokacin da suke fassara shi, har yanzu ba su bayyana rubutun da murya yadda ya kamata ba yayin rera waƙar, don haka, ba a samun nasarar ɓangaren daidaiton fasaha ba. Wane jawabi ne daga malamar, a matsayin wani nau'i na martani mai gina jiki, zai sauƙaƙa wannan koyo ga ɗaliban?
answer_a: Fassarar da kyau sosai idan aka yi la'akari da salon aikin. Sai dai, a cikin kiɗan murya, yana da muhimmanci cewa rubutun ya dace da waƙoƙin da suka dace, don haka za su iya bayyana waɗannan fannonin tare
answer_b: Ina taya ku murna kan fassarar da kuka yi ta gwaninta a kan wakar. Yanzu, yana da muhimmanci cewa, yayin fassara waka ta muryoyi, mawakan su saurari juna don samun daidaituwa sosai a tsakaninsu
answer_c: Yayi kyau har zuwa nan; amma har yanzu akwai sauran gyara wajen fassarar aikin. Don tabbatar da furucin rubutun ya dace, ina ba da shawarar a sake duba karatun score ɗin sau da yawa.
answer_d: An samu fasaha da fassarar aikin sosai. Amma, don kammala aikin, yana da muhimmanci a ƙarfafa furucin rubutun yayin da ake rera waƙa. Wannan zai taimaka wajen fahimtar ma'anarsa kuma ya sa aiwatar da kiɗan ya zama mafi inganci.

question: Don fara sashin Tsara da Yadawa, a ajin sakandare na Shekara ta 2, wata malama ta gudanar da kimantawa ta gano matsala (diagnostic assessment) don tantance yadda ɗalibai ke ɗaukar tsari (design) da rassan sa daban-daban. Bayan an yi kimantawar, malamar ta gano cewa ɗaliban suna da rudaddiyar fahimta game da zane-zanen masana'antu (industrial design), domin suna danganta shi ne kawai da ƙera sassa na masana'antu a kan manyan matakai. Wace aiki malamar za ta iya ba ɗaliban don su fahimci ma'anar zane-zanen masana'antu?
answer_a: Kalli kayayyakin zane-zane na masana'antu don nazartar su, rarraba su, da kuma zana shacin kayayyakin da aka baje koli
answer_b: Zaɓi kayayyakin ƙira da ake samu a cikin aji don binciko asalin su, cigaban su, da kuma dangantakar su da yanayin samar da su
answer_c: Fasali kayan zane na masana'antu ta hanyar ɗaukar hoto, don manufar ƙirƙirar sabon kayan zane wanda zai magance buƙatun yanzu
answer_d: Binciko sanannun kayayyakin ƙira da suka fito a tarihin ƙirar masana'antu, don daga baya ƙirƙiro wani kayan ƙira mai la'akari da buƙatun mahallin

question: Wata malama a aji na biyu na sakandire za ta yi aiki tare da ɗalibanta a kan rukuni mai suna Matsalolin Al'umma a cikin Fasahar Kallo, tana haɓaka manufar: "Yi hukunci mai mahimmanci game da ayyukan da ke gabatar da matsalolin al'umma, bisa ga nazarin abubuwan alamomi da yanayin samar da ayyukan." Don magance wannan manufar, za ta roƙe su su ƙirƙiri wani sassaka bisa ga wannan taken. Wace jerin ayyuka ce za ta ba da damar magance manufar koyo da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Yi nazarin aikin sassaka na zamani, gano muhimman manufofinsa, kuma ka tsara sassake bisa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan manufofin
answer_b: Ka tsara sassaka bisa ga matsalolin zamantakewa, ka tantance shawarar tare da abokin aiki, kuma ka ƙirƙiri sassakar bisa ga wannan tantancewar
answer_c: rubuta kasida a kan wakilcin matsalolin zamantakewa a cikin zane-zane, haɗa muhimman ra'ayoyi daga rubutun, sannan ka ƙirƙiri wani sassaka bisa ga kasidar
answer_d: Yi bincike a kan sassaka-sassaka waɗanda suka shafi jigo, ka kafa alaƙa tsakanin abubuwan harshen gani da manufar faɗakarwa ta waɗannan ayyukan, kuma ka tsara wani sassake bisa ga binciken

question: A cikin aji na shekara ta huɗu na sakandare, lokacin koyarwar darasin 'Binciken Harsunan Fasaha na Zamaninmu', malamin ya gabatar da ayyukan mai ɗaukar hoto na sabbin dabaru, Man Ray, ga ɗalibai kuma ya bayyana ma'anar rayogram, yana fassara shi a matsayin fasaha ta samun hotuna ba tare da amfani da kyamara ba. Bayan bayanin, wasu ɗalibai sun nuna cewa ba su fahimci ma'anar ba, don haka malamin ya yanke shawarar kafa kwatanci tsakanin wannan fasahar da yanayi na rayuwar yau da kullum. Wane yanayi na rayuwar yau da kullum za a iya kwatanta fasahar rayogram da shi?
answer_a: Da surorin da madubi ke nunawa idan hasken rana ya riske shi
answer_b: Da alamun da ke ragewa a jiki bayan an yi rana tare da zobe
answer_c: Da siffofin da ake gani a ƙasa lokacin da wani abu ya hana hasken rana
answer_d: Da tabon da bututun ruwa ke barin a kan ciyawa idan ya sha rana

question: Lokacin haɓaka sashin Kafa Na'urorin Multimedia, a aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare, malami zai yi aiki tare da ɗalibai a kan manufar: "Ku ƙirƙiri kafa na'urar multimedia a wani wuri na makarantar don maida hankalin al'ummar makarantar a kan batutuwan yanayi da muhalli." Ɗalibai za su yi aiki a rukuni don tsara shawarar, wadda za a gabatar da ita a wani wuri na musamman na cibiyar ilimi. Wane ilimin farko ne ya zama wajibi ga ɗalibai don su magance manufar da aka gabatar yadda ya kamata?
answer_a: Hanyar aiki don bunƙasa ayyukan gani
answer_b: Dabarun da ake amfani da su a ayyukan shigar da kafofin watsa labarai iri-iri (multimedia installation works)
answer_c: Abubuwa masu bayyanawa na harshen gani na sauti da bidiyo
answer_d: Jigogin muhalli a cikin ayyukan zubin na'urorin multimedia

question: A aji na huɗu na sakandare, yayin bunƙasa darasin zanen bango, wani malami tare da ɗalibansa sun yi nazari kan tarihin zanen bango da manyan halayensa, suna ƙara fahimtar abin da suka koya da ziyarar ilimi zuwa Gidan Tarihi na Buɗe Sama na Valparaíso, domin su haɓaka nasu tsare-tsaren zanen bango. Bayan aikin na fili, malamin ya gabatar da wani kimantawa ta gina-ilimi na aikin, wato shirya tarin aiki wanda zai cika manufa mai zuwa: “Don bayyana ra’ayoyi masu jan hankali na kai ta hanyar ƙirƙirar zanen bango wanda aka samo wahayi daga ayuka biyu na Gidan Tarihi na Buɗe Sama na Valparaíso”. Idan aka yi la’akari da manufar kimantawa da aka gabatar, wane aiki ne ya dace a haɗa shi cikin tarin aikin?
answer_a: Zana zane-zane na bangon da aka zaɓa, tare da haɗa da ra'ayoyin mutum da hukunce-hukuncen kyawun ayyukan
answer_b: Shirin aikin zane a bango, wanda ya haɗa da kayayyaki, lokuta, da matakai da ake bukata don kammala shi
answer_c: Tattara fayilolin hotunan bango da aka zaɓa, ciki har da ra'ayoyi da tunani a kan ayyukan, da kuma shaci-tafukan su
answer_d: Buga ra'ayoyi, hotuna, da zanen matakan ƙirƙirar aikin, haɗe da abubuwan kallo da bayanai na zaɓaɓɓun ayyukan

question: A cikin sashin 'Fahimtar Masu Fasaha na Zamani da Sake Kirkirar Ayyukansu', a cikin ajin sakandare na aji na 4, wata malama tana aiki tare da ɗalibanta kan aiki na farko, wanda ya ƙunshi aikin bincike na rukuni wanda manufarsa ita ce: "Binciko siffofi na tsari da yanayin samarwa na nunin fasaha daga ƙungiyoyin fasaha na zamani." A ƙarshen binciken, malamar za ta gudanar da kimantawa mai ginawa na ayyukan bisa ga ma'aunin kimantawa. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan masu nuni da za a haɗa a cikin ma'aunin kimantawa zai ba da damar tabbatar da cimma manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Suna tantance manufar bayyanawa ta mahimmanci na zaɓaɓɓun zane-zane na zamani masu wakilci na zaɓaɓɓun ƙungiyar.
answer_b: Suna tsara wani aikin fasaha na zamani, suna la'akari da sifofin asali na ƙungiyar da aka yi nazari a kai.
answer_c: Suna bayyana halaye na ayyukan fasahar zamani na ƙungiyar da aka zaɓa, suna danganta su da madaidaitan abubuwan zamantakewa da tarihi na yankin
answer_d: Suna tabbatar da zaɓin zayyanar fasahohi na zamani daga zaɓaɓɓen rukuni, suna la'akari da abubuwa masu canzawa kamar su abubuwan da suke so da kuma dangantakarsu da abubuwan da suka samu

question: Malamin aji na shida, a cikin darasin Rhythm da Kiɗa, zai yi atisaye da ɗalibansa akan wasu siffofin rhythm don su iya buga su da kayan kiɗa kuma su gane su a cikin atisayen sauraro. Wane aiki ne ya dace don haɓaka ƙwarewar ɗalibai ta banbance siffofin rhythm ta hanyar ji?
answer_a: Haɗa siffofin kidan da ke biye da juna da kalmomi
answer_b: Zana yayin da kake sauraron siffofin kari a kiɗa
answer_c: Yi tafiya kana sauraron siffofin kari a cikin kiɗa
answer_d: Kwaikwayi shugabanci na sifofin jigo a cikin kiɗa

question: Malamar ajin shida tana jagorantar atishin gama gari na guntuwar kida don busa, gitar, da ganguna. Lokacin atishin, ta lura cewa a rukunin busa, wasu ɗalibai ba sa aiwatar da furtawar staccato a cikin jimlar sauti. Don amsa, ta yanke shawarar canza dabarar ajin domin ta gyara kuskuren wasan da waɗannan ɗalibai suka nuna. Wane shisshigi ne daga malamar ya dace don gyara rashin staccatos a cikin wasan?
answer_a: Ku bi diddigin sashin ɗan littafin tare da ɗalibai, ku gano matsalar kuma ku maimaita har sai kun cimma nasarar aiwatarwa daidai
answer_b: Gudanar da babban atisaye, kuma a ƙarshen ajin, umurci masu busa fiyula su sake nazarin yadda suke furta busar a gida, a gaban madubi
answer_c: Yi nazarin kai a cikin aji wanda zai ba da sarari don yin bita tare da kowane ɗalibi a kan sashen da ke nuna matsalolin aiwatarwa
answer_d: Dakatar da atisayen kuma ka bayyana wa ɗaliban tushen nazarin yadda ake furta kalmomi da suke nuna takamaiman matsaloli a cikinsa

question: Wata malama tana aiki a kan ƙwarewar saurarawa da hankali tare da ɗalibanta na aji na biyar. Don yin haka, za ta gabatar da kiɗa na nau'o'i da salo daban-daban da nufin cewa ɗaliban su gano tsare-tsaren kiɗa masu sauƙi, kamar sautin jagora da rakiya, sautin haɗaka, sautin bambance-bambance, da sauransu. Waɗanne kayan aikin kiɗa, da suka dace da ci gaban ƙwarewar da kuma manufar da aka gabatar, ya dace malamar ta yi amfani da su?
answer_a: Sauti da maki
answer_b: Mai ji da mai tsara waka
answer_c: Bidiyo da musikogiram
answer_d: Bidiyo da maki

question: Malamar za ta yi aiki tare da ɗalibanta na aji na 5 a kan fasahar buga kayan kaɗe-kaɗe da rera waƙa a haɗin kai (harmony), don shirya wani gungu na wani yanki na kiɗan Latin Amurka. Dangane da yanayin da ya gabata, wane aikin motsa jiki ne ya dace da ɗaliban ya kamata sun yi a baya don fara haɓaka aikin murya mai yawa (polyphonic work)?
answer_a: Karatun atisayen polyrhythmic, bugawa da duka
answer_b: Sadar da gajeren saƙaƙƙen mai ɓangarori biyu tare da rakiyar sarewa
answer_c: Rera jerin sautin jituwa a cikin ƙungiyar mawaƙa, inda kowace rukuni ke rera sauti ɗaya na jituwar sautin
answer_d: Aikin murya na rukuni tare da sauƙaƙan salo da aiwatarwar kayan kiɗa da aka fayyace

question: Malamin aji na 7 ya kammala wani darasi wanda yake da manufa kamar haka: "Rera waƙa da kaɗa waƙoƙi iri-iri, suna haɓaka ƙwarewa kamar su daidaiton kari (rhythm) da kuma sautin waƙa; da kuma amfani da hanyoyin bayyana ji na kiɗa." Don tabbatar da cikar wannan manufa, zai tantance ɗaliban ɗaya bayan ɗaya ta hanyar aikin rera waƙa da/ko kaɗa kayan kiɗa na waƙoƙin gargajiya na Chile, ta amfani da kayan kiɗa masu samar da sauti da na haɗa sauti (filiti, metallophone, melodica, keyboard, guitar, da ukulele). Wane rukuni na alamomi ne zai ba da damar cikakken bayani kan cika burin da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Sun yi daidai da sautin waƙar da aka yi a kai.
answer_b: Suna haɗa da faɗaɗaɗɗen ƙarfi mai ƙarfi (forte-piano) kamar yadda ya dace yayin da suke yin waƙar. ■ Suna kiyaye daidaiton kiɗa yayin da suke yin waƙar, suna bin alamun faɗakarwa na ainihin waƙar daidai.
answer_c: Suna fassara waƙa da sautin kiɗa daidai da yanki. ■ Suna haɗa abubuwan agogic da ƙarfin sauti daidai a cikin aikin
answer_d: Suna aiwatar da kari da waƙa daidai gwargwadon yanki. ■ Suna haɗa abubuwa a cikin fassarar kamar matsayi, gyarawa, da kuma lafazi, a tsakanin wasu.

question: Malami na aji na biyar zai tantance wannan manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Rarrabe ta hanyar sauraro halayen sauti da abubuwan harshen kiɗa, kuma ya wakilce su ta hanyoyi daban-daban." Wace aiki ce malamin ya gabatar da ita za ta ba da damar auna wannan manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Ɗalibai suna sauraron waƙoƙin kiɗa daban-daban, sannan sukan ƙirƙiri wani kundin haɗa-haɗi ta amfani da yankan motsin zuciyar da suka taso daga kiɗan da suka saurara
answer_b: Dalibai suna sauraron nau'o'in kiɗa daban-daban waɗanda suke so da kansu, sa'an nan kuma su ƙirƙiri rubutu wanda yake bayyana tunanin da ya fito daga gare su
answer_c: Dalibai suna sauraron kiɗa daga muhallinsu na kusa, sannan a cikin ƙungiyoyi, su ƙirƙiri wani tsari na bayyanar jiki wanda ke nuna motsin rai da suka taso daga sauraron nasu
answer_d: Ɗalibai suna sauraron waka sau da yawa yayin da suke zana zane marar misali na abubuwan daban-daban da suka fahimta a ciki, ta hanyar launuka, siffofi, da kuma layuka

question: A farkon darasin Zane a cikin Fasahar Zamani, wanda ke magana kan darajar alamomi na ayyuka a cikin mahallin al'adu, malami zai gudanar da tantancewar gano matsala don tantance ko ɗalibansa na aji na 6 sun gane manufar bayyanawa da jerin ayyukan ke nunawa. Bayan ya duba amsoshin, sai ya lura cewa yawancin ɗalibai suna nuna halaye na layi, siffa, da launi na zanen, ba tare da ambaton ra'ayoyin da suke isarwa ba. Wannan ya faɗakar da shi cewa dole ne ya yi aiki da su kan haɗa fahimtar alamomi na hotunan da ke cikin waɗannan ayyuka. Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ne ke taimaka wa ɗalibai su fahimci yadda za su tantance manufar bayyanawa ta wani aiki?
answer_a: Malamin ya ce wa ɗalibai su lura da ayyuka daban-daban na fasahar zamani kuma su gano jigogi na bai ɗaya da aka maimaita a cikinsu
answer_b: Malam ya gabatar da jerin ayyukan fasahar zamani ga ɗalibai kuma ya buƙace su su gane salon bayyanawa da hanyoyin aiki da masu fasahar suka yi amfani da su
answer_c: Malamar tana gabatar da ayyukan fasahar zamani daban-daban ga ɗalibai kuma tana neman su rubuta abubuwan da suke ji da launuka ko sifofin da aka wakilta a cikinsu ke haifarwa
answer_d: Malamin ya nuna wa ɗalibai zaɓi na wakilcin ayyukan fasaha na zamani kuma ya tambaye su su nuna irin ra'ayin duniya da masu fasahar suka samu bisa nazarin abubuwan da suka lura da su a cikin ayyukan.

question: Malamar aji na shida ta tsara manufa kamar haka don kimantawa ta gano matsala: “Don nuna ta hanyar zane da girman jikin mutum.” A matsayin babbar aiki na ajin, ta ɗora wa ɗalibai alhakin yin zane-zanen mutum guda uku: ɗaya na yaro, ɗaya na babba, da kuma ɗaya na babba mai shekaru. Bayan karɓar ayyukan, malamar ta lura cewa wasu ɗalibai sun zana jikin mutane da “siffofi kamar itace” (stick figures), kuma ta kammala cewa wannan rukuni yana da matsala wajen nuna siffofi a cikin girma uku (three dimensions). Saboda haka, ta yanke shawarar fara aji na gaba ta hanyar magance wannan fannin koyo. Wace daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ce za ta ba malamar damar ƙarfafa musamman fannin da aka gano a matsayin kalubale ga ɗalibanta?
answer_a: Ku duba zane-zanen gaba da gefe na siffofin mutane a cikin littattafan nazarin halittar jiki, sa'an nan ku kwafi siffofin da aka nazarta.
answer_b: Shirkokin siffa (geometric bodies) da alaƙarsu da sassan jiki dabam-dabam, sannan a yi amfani da su wajen zana ɗanƙamman surar mutum (human figure)
answer_c: Auna ma'aunin jikin abokin karatunka don gano dangantakar da ke tsakanin sassan jikinsa sannan ka yi zane-zanen wakilci na siffar abokin karatunka
answer_d: Zana ginshiƙai da alkiblar sassan jiki a hotunan mutane don haɗa siffofi sannan a yi kwafin adadin jikin ɗan Adam da aka bincika

question: Malami yana fara sashen Hotunan Dijital a Fasahar Zane tare da ɗaliban aji na 7. Malamin ya gabatar da aiki mai zuwa ga ɗaliban: su kirkiri hotunan yanayi na hasashe ta hanyar zane na dijital a cikin shirin gyaran hoto. Wane ilimin tsari na aiki na farko ne tushe ga ɗaliban su mallaka don cimma manufar?
answer_a: Kayan aikin kula da shanyewar jiki
answer_b: Kula da kayan aikin tasiri
answer_c: Gudanar da kayan aikin yanke da liƙa
answer_d: Gudanar da kayan aikin zaɓi

question: Malami yana tsarawa sashen darasi mai suna Mutane da Kasa a ajin shekara ta takwas, yana la'akari da manufar: "Kirkiro taswira ta tarihin rayuwa bisa ga fahimta, ji da kuma ra'ayoyin da suka samu daga rayuwarsu." Don kirkirar wannan taswirar, malamin ya gabatar da amfani da dabarar hada hotuna (collage). Wace jerin ayyuka ce ta fi dacewa don jagorantar ɗalibai wajen kirkirar taswirar tarihin rayuwarsu?
answer_a: Ƙirƙiri wani haɗin-hotuna na tarihin rayuwa, yi nazari kan sassan shi daban-daban, zana taswirar shi, kuma haɗa ɓangarori na haɗin-hotunan ciki
answer_b: Haɗa hotuna a cikin taswirar wuri, haɗa zane da zane-zane, yi nazarin wuraren yanki da aka rufe a ciki
answer_c: Rubuta rubutu na tarihin rayuwa, tantance nau'o'in ilimin taswira daban-daban, zana taswirar, kuma haɗa da hotuna masu bugu da zane
answer_d: Yi tunani a kan tarihin rayuwarsu, tattara da liƙa takardu a kan babban shafi, zana taswirar, da haɗa zane-zane

question: Malami zai yi aiki tare da ɗaliban aji na 6 a kan manufa mai zuwa: “Don haɓaka ayyukan buga hotuna ta amfani da dabarar monotype mai launi.” Waɗanne ilimin da suka gabata ɗalibai ke buƙata don amfani da wannan dabarar daidai?
answer_a: Daidaita launi
answer_b: Amfani da injin buga takardu
answer_c: Tsaida tawada a faranti
answer_d: Gwaji na jihar a cikin tsarin sarrafa hoto

question: A cikin aji na aji takwas, yayin da ake koyar da fasahar zamani, wata malama tana bayani kan batun fasahar shigarwa (installation). Don yin haka, ɗaliban sun kalli bidiyoyi na shigarwa daban-daban, kuma tare sun tantance halayen wannan nau'in fasaha. A matsayin aikin ƙarshe, ɗaliban, waɗanda aka tsara a cikin ƙungiyoyi, sun ƙirƙiri wani shigarwa na ɗan lokaci a cikin ajin, ta amfani da kayayyakin da suka kawo daga gidajensu. Yayin da take lura da aikin, malamar ta lura cewa ɗaya daga cikin ƙungiyoyin tana yin sifofi na bazuwa da zaren da aka lika a bangon aji. Wace rashin fahimta game da abun ciki na shigarwa ce ta fito fili a cikin aikin da ɗaliban suka gabatar?
answer_a: Suna kasa danganta siffofin da aka yi amfani da su da wurin da aka zaɓa don shigarwar
answer_b: Ba sa la'akari da irin tallafin da ya kamata shigarwar ta samu
answer_c: Basa amfani da sararin ta hanyar amfani da ra'ayoyi daban-daban da ya kamata shigarwa ta kasance da su
answer_d: Ba sa la'akari da halayen kayan da ya kamata a yi amfani da su a cikin wani aiki (ko gini ko shigarwa)

question: A ƙarshen fannin Fasahar Girkawa da Fasahar Zamani, malama za ta tantance ɗalibanta na aji na 8 dangane da cimma manufa kamar haka: "Su haɗa kai su ƙirƙira fasahar girkawa a cikin aji, bisa nazarin dangantakar da ke tsakanin mutane da yanayi." Wanne ne aikin ɗalibai daga cikin waɗannan ke nuna cimma wannan manufar?
answer_a: Dalibai sun yi amfani da fenti da kayan da aka sake sarrafawa, wato abubuwan yau da kullum masu muhimmanci da aka kawo daga gidajensu, kuma suka kafa su a wurare daban-daban a cikin aji
answer_b: Dalibai sun sanya madubi a saman rufin ɗaya daga cikin kusurwoyin ajin, yana nuna benen da aka shirya a baya da ciyawa, ganye, da zane-zanen wuraren kore da ƙungiyar ta yi
answer_c: Dalibai suna kirkirar kayan sawa daga tufafin da aka sake amfani da su, wanda suka samo asali daga canjin yanayi, kuma su ne ke sanyawa yayin da suke bayyana yadda suka yi su.
answer_d: Dalibai sun shirya bidiyo da hotunan ajin da aka gyara ta hanyar dijital, tare da launuka da siffofi daban-daban da ke nuni ga dabi'a, suna canja yanayin wurin da aka gyara

question: Wani Malam, a cikin ajin SS 3, a cikin Darasin "Abin da Kiɗa Ke Nuna Mana," ya fara tattauna Manufar Koyo mai zuwa: "Don ƙirƙira wani ƙaramin aikin kiɗa tare da haɗin gwiwa, dangane da wani yanayin sauti na musamman, ta yin amfani da muryarsu, jikinsu, kayan kiɗa, da abubuwa masu fitar da sauti iri-iri, domin zurfafa bincike a kan sautin kusa da suke kewaye da ɗaliban." Wace dabara ce ta fi dacewa ga ɗalibai su fara aiki kan manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Don nemo abubuwa daban-daban masu sauti waɗanda ke sauƙaƙa tsarin ƙirƙirar kiɗa
answer_b: Don gudanar da bincike kan yanayin sauti na ƙauye da birni
answer_c: Don gane da sauraron sautuka daban-daban waɗanda suka haɗa wani yanayin sauti na musamman
answer_d: Zaɓar kayan kiɗa da kowane ɗan ƙungiyar ya ƙware a kansu kuma a yi su a filin jama'a

question: A aji na farko na sakandare, malami zai koyar da ɗalibai kan manufa mai zuwa: "Sanin halayen kromatisim da yadda ake amfani da shi a cikin waƙoƙi daban-daban." Malamin ya riga ya bayyana manufofin, amma ya yanke shawarar wakilta wannan siffar ta kiɗa a hoto ta hanyar amfani da misali kwatanci. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan misalan kwatancin ya dace don inganta fahimtar ɗalibai game da manufar kromatisim?
answer_a: A cikin ruwan tabarau da kayan aikin gani, yana yiwuwa a sami kalararrakin launi (chromaticisms) lokacin da abubuwa suka bayyana kamar an zana iyakarsu da launukan bakan gizo
answer_b: A kan madannin, akwai not din D, D sharp, da E; ko kuma, E, E flat, da D, waɗanda sune jere na not ɗin waƙa
answer_c: A cikin karatun akord, ana gina akord ɗin babbar, ƙaramar, ragu, da ƙari ta hanyar canza mataki na 3 da na 5
answer_d: A cikin zane, yana da matukar yiwuwa a lura da canjin launuka, inda za mu ga raguwar launin, kamar daga ja zuwa lemo sannan kuma zuwa rawaya

question: Malamin sakandare, a aji na biyu, a cikin mahallin jigon nan 'Me Waka Ke Gaya Mana', zai tantance ɗalibai da wannan manufa mai zuwa: "Yin kimantawa mai zurfi ga bayyanannu da ayyukan kiɗa daga Chile da duniya waɗanda ke bayyana a al'adar baka, rubutacciya, da ta jama'a, tare da sadar da tushensu ta hanyoyin magana, hoto, sauti, da motsi na jiki." Domin wannan aiki, dole ne ɗalibai su sanya wa aikinsu tambari na gida. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ne ya dace don tantance manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Yi nazarin sigar wata shahararriyar wakar yankinku, inda za a tantance ma’auninta, salon waƙar, sautinta, da tsarinta.
answer_b: Zaɓi mawaki-mawallafin waƙoƙi na misali daga yankin, sannan ka rubuta tarihin harkar waƙarsa
answer_c: Yi nazari a kan rubutun waƙa da marubuci wakili daga yankin ku, tare da danganta kalmomin waƙar da ainihin halin da birnin yake ciki
answer_d: Rubuta ɗan gajeren kasida na waƙoƙin da makaɗan gargajiya na mashaya ke yawan kunnawa a yankinka, kana bayyana nau'insu, mawallafansu, da kuma maƙirƙiransu

question: Wata Malama/Malami, a ajin sakandare na shekara ta biyu, za ta/zai tantance koyon ɗalibai game da manufa mai zuwa: "Ƙirƙirar sabon sauti na kiɗa na musamman don guntun shirin motsi na Tom da Jerry, ta amfani da kayan kaɗe-kaɗe daban-daban, kayayyakin yau da kullum da/ko na'urorin lantarki." Don cimma hakan, dole ne su gudanar da aikin aikace na kiɗa, wanda za a iya gabatar da shi kai tsaye a lokacin ɗayan azuzuwan ko kuma ta tsarin bidiyo. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ma'aunai ne zai bada damar nuna nasarar cikar manufar?
answer_a: Suna kula da daidaituwa tsakanin jerin motsin rai da kiɗan da aka kirkira
answer_b: Suna amfani da banbancin sautuka da launukan sauti masu kawo wadatar ga shirinta na waƙe-waƙe da aka tsara
answer_c: Suna amfani da kayan kiɗa masu faɗakarwa yadda ya dace, bisa ga wurin da halayen jerin zane mai motsi
answer_d: Suna amfani da albarkatun fasaha ta hanyar kirkira dangane da bukatun kiɗa na shawarar sauti

question: Malamiya tana shiryawa darasin "Dabarun Buga Zane da Littafin Mai Zane" ga ajin shekara ta farko, bisa ga manufar: "Sanin da kuma amfani da dabarun buga zane." Don darasi na farko, za ta zaɓi wata dabara ta maimaita hoto wacce za ta ba da damar gabatarwa ta farko ga dabarun bugu kuma wacce za ta dace da muhallin darasin, ganin cewa ɗaliban ba su da kayan aiki na musamman. Wane aiki ne zai ba ɗalibai damar cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Yi zanuka domin bugun allo
answer_b: Yi matattakala don linocut
answer_c: Yi darussan laushi a kan ma'auni da busasshiyar allura
answer_d: Ku fara kasuwanci bisa wani maudu'i da ɗalibai suka zaɓa

question: A cikin aji na biyu na sashin Harsunan Injiniya da Lantarki, wata malama tana aiki tare da ɗaliban shekara ta huɗu da manufar: "Don yin zurfin tunani a kan rukunan ba da labari na harshen sauti da gani." A lokacin ajin, ta tattauna da ɗaliban game da kallo (shot), fage (scene), da jere na sauti da gani (sequence), tana nuna misalai ta amfani da gajerun faifai daga fina-finai shahararru. Bayan sun lura da misalan, wata ɗaliba ta ɗaga hannu kuma ta ce ba ta fahimci bambanci tsakanin fage da jere na sauti da gani ba. Wane bayani ne daga malamar zai warware tantamar ɗalibar kuma ya cika misalan da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Wuri (scene) guntuwar fim ce da ake dauka tun daga lokacin da kyamara ta fara aiki har zuwa yankewa. Sabanin haka, silsila (sequence) ita ce jimillar waɗannan guntu-guntu.
answer_b: Ana haifar da waje idan halayen da ke cikin firam suka motsa yayin labarin. Sabanin haka kuma, silsila tana samuwa ne idan kyamara ce ke motsi.
answer_c: Yanayi guntu ne na labarin da ke faruwa a waje guda. Sabanin haka, jeri na gani da ji yana bayyana yanayi na wasan kwaikwayo cikakke, wanda ya kunshi farko, ci gaba, da karshe
answer_d: Fage an tsara shi ne dangane da wani wuri da lokaci na musamman inda sararin labari ke faruwa. Sabanin haka, jeri yana fahimtar sararin labarin sosai, yana la’akari da duniyar labari wacce za’a iya wakilta daga wurare da lokuta daban-daban.

question: Don aiki akan sashin Sanin Masu Zane na Zamani da Sake Kirkirar Ayyukansu, wata malamar sakandare ta shirya gudanar da aji tare da ɗaliban shekara ta huɗu inda za ta zurfafa bincike kan aikin Frida Kahlo, tana mai nuna mahimmancin tarihin rayuwarta a cikin kirkirar fasaharta. A matsayin aiki, za ta nemi ɗaliban su sake fassara wani zane na mai fasahar bisa ga tunaninsu da salon su na kashin kai. Yayin da ake kirkirar zane-zanen farko, malamar ta lura cewa ɗaliban suna kwaikwayon ayyukan maimakon su sake fassararsu. Waɗanne tambayoyi ne suka dace ga malamar ta yi wa ɗaliban don jagoranci da sauƙaƙe bayyanar da kashin kai a cikin ayyukansu?
answer_a: Waɗanne abubuwa a rayuwar Frida Kahlo aka sake ba da labarinsu a cikin ayyukanta? Waɗanne irin ji kake lura da su take bayyanawa? Waɗanne hotuna da launuka za ka yi amfani da su don wakiltar waɗannan ji?
answer_b: Yaya kuke tunanin aikin Frida Kahlo zai kasance idan da wahalar rayuwarta ba ta yi yawa ba? Ta wace hanya za ku wakilci wahala? Waɗanne hotuna da launuka za ku yi amfani da su?
answer_c: Waɗanne abubuwa a rayuwarku ne suka shafeku kamar abin da ya faru da Frida Kahlo? Waɗanne irin jiye-jiye waɗannan tunane-tunane suke sanyawa a ranku? Waɗanne irin hotuna da launuka kuke ganin za su bayyana waɗannan jiye-jiyen?
answer_d: Shin kana tuna halayen zanen Frida Kahlo? Yaya amfani da abubuwan yaren gani ke taimakawa wajen bayyana ji? Wadanne halaye na aikinta kake son bayyanawa a cikin zane-zanenka?

question: Malami na sakandare, a ajin shekara ta 4, yana shirin wani kimantawa don kammala darasin Fasahar Zamani, inda manufar za ta kasance ƙirƙirar tsare-tsare masu halaye na gani waɗanda ke nuna salon da masu fasahar zamani suka yi amfani da shi a cikin aikinsu. A cikin wannan darasi, ɗaliban sun koyi game da masu fasaha daban-daban na rabin na biyu na karni na 20, suna mai da hankali kan aikin mai fasahar Pop, Roy Lichtenstein, don haka kimantawar za ta ƙunshi sake fasalin wani aiki na fasaha na gargajiya tare da salon zanen wannan mai fasahar. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin ya dace a haɗa shi a cikin jagorar kimantawa?
answer_a: Sun gabatar da abubuwan ban dariya da ban haushi a cikin shawararsu
answer_b: Sun yi amfani da faɗaɗɗen zaɓin launuka tare da ɗan goge a cikin shawararsu
answer_c: Suna haɗa hotunan daukar hoto da abubuwa tare da fenti a cikin tsarin shirinsu (ko: bayanin da suke son gabatarwa)
answer_d: Suna amfani da ɗigo-ɗigo, zane-zane na ƙetare (hatching), da baƙaƙen layi don zayyana siffofin da suka haɗa da shawarwarin su

question: Malamin sakandare, a aji na Farko, a sashin fasahar dijital, yana shirin tsara wani tantancewa wanda ya ƙunshi gabatarwa ta rukuni wanda manufarsa ita ce: “Tantance ayyukan fasahar dijital, tare da gano halayen da suka takamaimai ga wannan kafa.” La’akari da wannan manufa da ke sama, waɗanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomi ne ya kamata su kasance a cikin tsarin tantancewar?
answer_a: Suna gardama a kan zaɓin ayyukan, suna bayyana ra'ayoyinsu da fahimtominsu game da su
answer_b: Suna kwatanta hotunan da aka gyara, suna gano hanyoyin gyara da aka yi amfani da su don ƙirƙirar hotunan
answer_c: Suna tabbatar da aikin fasahar dijital ɗin nasu, suna bayyana manhajojin da aka yi amfani da su wajen ƙirƙirar shi
answer_d: Suna binciken ayyukan zane na dijital, suna gano kayan aikin dijital da aka yi amfani da su don kwaikwayon kayan zahiri

question: Bayanin da za a fassara: A cikin ajin ɗalibai na shekara ta 4, a ƙarshen zango na farko, wani malamin sakandare zai tantance ayyukan fasaha na ɗaliban, inda kowane ɗayan ya haɓaka ayyuka daban-daban, zanuka, sassa biyu masu girma da sassa uku masu girma. Wace ce daga cikin hanyoyin tantancewa masu zuwa za ta ba malamin damar tabbatar da koyon ɗaliban, bisa ga manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Kogo
answer_b: Taskar Ayyuka
answer_c: Littafin mai fasaha
answer_d: Shisshigi na fasaha

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Malami a aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare yana shirya jagorar tantancewa don kimanta nasarar manufa mai zuwa: "Suna nazarin bidiyo don banbanta hanyoyi daban-daban na aiki da yaren sauti-da-gani." Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya ƙunshi alamar nuni wadda ya kamata ta kasance a cikin jagorar tantancewar?
answer_a: Suna tantance kayan gani da sauti ta hanyar banbance hotuna, shafuka, da kuma tsawon lokaci (temporality)
answer_b: Suna kallon bidiyo kuma suna bayyana gamsuwarsu game da ra'ayoyin da aka gabatar
answer_c: Sun binciko ra'ayoyi na kansu game da bidiyon bisa ga sakamakon bincikensu na fasaha
answer_d: Suna tabbatar da ra'ayoyi na wani aikin gani-da-sauti ta amfani da sakamakon binciken fasaharsu
